data.descriptionPlain:
About Us
Paytm is India's payment Super App offering consumers and merchants the most
comprehensive payment services. As the pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in
India, today Paytm stands as India’s largest payment company by Users, Merchants, Payment
Transactions, and Revenue. Paytm’s mission is to drive financial inclusion across the nation and
bring half a billion Indians into the mainstream economy through technology-led financial
services.
Paytm enables commerce for small merchants and distributes various financial services
offerings to its consumers and merchants in partnership with financial institutions. Paytm has
been a trailblazer in the merchant space by introducing innovative solutions like QR codes to
accept payments and the Sound-box to reconcile payments via voice alerts. Furthermore, we
are actively distributing loans to these partners via our 'Paytm for Business' application.

Role Overview
We are looking for a high-performing Hunter Account Director to drive net-new enterprise
business for Pi Commerce. This is a pure hunting role focused entirely on acquiring large
enterprise logos, owning complex end-to-end sales cycles, and driving meaningful revenue
growth.
Operating at the intersection of AI, SaaS, and customer engagement, you will be responsible for
positioning a highly differentiated platform directly to CXOs and executive leadership teams
across a diverse range of industries.

Key Responsibilities

 Own the end-to-end enterprise sales cycle — from initial prospecting and discovery to
commercial negotiation and closure.
 Drive new logo acquisition aggressively across large enterprises (BFSI, Retail, Telecom,
Healthcare, etc.).
 Build and manage a robust, qualified sales pipeline through outbound hunting, professional
networking, and strategic account mapping.
 Lead CXO-level conversations, masterfully articulating business value propositions around
AI-led customer engagement.
 Conduct deep, consultative discovery to thoroughly understand client challenges across
engagement, retention, and communication systems.
 Collaborate closely with internal Pre-Sales, Product, and Solutions teams to architect
tailored technical solutions and custom demos.
 Lead RFP/RFQ responses, comprehensive proposal development, and high-value
contract/commercial negotiations.
 Position Pi Commerce strategically as a large-scale business transformation platform,
distinct from transactional messaging or simple campaign tools.
 Maintain absolute CRM discipline, ensuring highly accurate revenue forecasting and clear
pipeline hygiene.
 Represent Paytm at major industry events, critical client summits, and high-profile strategic
forums.

What We’re Looking For
 5–8 years of elite track record in Enterprise SaaS / CPaaS / MarTech / AI platform
enterprise sales.
 Proven success in closing large, complex enterprise deals characterized by multi-
stakeholder structures and extended sales cycles.
 A fierce, dedicated hunter mindset with clear evidence of high performance in new business
and net-new logo acquisition.
 Extensive experience engaging, pitching to, and building long-term trust with CXOs,
business heads, and digital/marketing leaders.
 An ability to sell consultatively, naturally translating deep operational business problems into
elegant, technology-led solutions.
 Strong commercial acumen equipped with expert-level proficiency in deal structuring, risk
management, and commercial negotiations.
 Thrived and demonstrated high comfort levels working in fast-paced, fluid, and high-growth
organizational environments.

Why Join This Role

 Strategic Impact: Be a key pillar of a high-growth, strategic priority business unit embedded
within Paytm.
 Cutting-Edge Product: Sell a highly differentiated, category-defining AI-led enterprise
engagement platform.
 Scale & Transformation: Gain the opportunity to lead and impact large-scale
transformations across India's largest corporate enterprises.
 High Visibility: Enjoy a high-impact, visible executive track role with a direct line of sight to
overall revenue and national market expansion.

data.descriptionPlain:
About Us:  Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytm’s mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.

About the Team: Finance Team is responsible for allocating resources, creating economic forecasts, reviewing opportunities for equity and debt financing, and other functions within your organization. 

About the Role:  The role includes managing all account payables and receivables, accounting operations, and Daily work of Reconciliation of Revenue & expense items. Managing a small set of team and Vendor Management.

Expectations/ Requirements:
1. Handling the accounting functions such as Procure to Pay accounting, GL accounting, Fixed Assets accounting, reporting, reconciliations, etc. 
2. Vendor payment management: - Should be well versed in vendor payment management.
3. Planning & driving month/ quarter/ year-end accounts closing activities within agreed timelines.
4. Ensuring Compliances of direct/indirect taxes along with all required approvals as per the company's policy. 
5. Liaising with various internal stakeholders or business users for settlement of vendor advances, timely clearance of vendor payments, and resolving their issues.
6. Maintaining and extracting reports/MIS at Cost center/Profit Center level.
7. Verification/Vouching of custom-related documents: - Bill of entry, Bill of Lading or Airway Bill, import license, Letter of Credit or LC, etc.


 Superpowers/ Skills that will help you succeed in this role:

 1. Minimum experience in Accounting is 6 years -10 years in the Payable domain.
2.  Should have good knowledge of  Accounting entries, GST, TDS, and Foreign remittances
3. Must have worked in SAP Accounting.
4. Proficient in handling Statutory Audits, Tax Audits Internal Audits, and all other kinds of Audits as and when required by the company.
5. Should be well versed with all accrual and provisioning concepts and have knowledge of maintaining and extracting reports/MIS at the Cost center/Profit Center level.
6. Should have good knowledge of Good communication and strong interpersonal skills. 
7. Hard-working, detail-oriented, and good team player. 

 Education: Post-Graduation in Finance / Qualified CA / CA Intermediate

 Why join us ? : A collaborative output-driven program that brings cohesiveness across businesses through technology Improve the average revenue per use by increasing the cross-sell opportunities solid 360 feedback from your peer teams on your support of their goals Respect, that is earned, not demanded from your peers and manager.

Compensation: If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you with an enviable 500 mn+ registered users, 21 mn+ merchants and depth of data in our ecosystem, we are in a unique position to democratize credit for deserving consumers & merchants – and we are committed to it. India’s largest digital lending story is brewing here. It’s your opportunity to be a part of the story!

A pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytm’s mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them into the mainstream economy with the help of technology.

 Work closely with the campaign delivery and optimization team to monitor and deliver expected results to the advertiser
 Lead initiatives which require significant cross team collaboration to build innovative 
 Provide constant feedback to the product team to improve 

Desired Qualifications:
 7+ years of experience in 
preferred)

skills required

Compensation: If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you With enviable 500 mn+ registered users, 21 mn+ merchants and depth of data in our ecosystem, we are in a unique position to democratize credit for deserving consumers & merchants – and we are committed to it. India’s largest digital lending story is brewing here. It’s your opportunity to be a part of the story!

Buyer – Admin & HR Procurement:

Role Overview:

The Buyer – Admin & HR Procurement will be responsible for managing end-to-end sourcing and procurement activities across Administration, Facility Management, Lease Rentals, and HR-related categories. The role includes vendor sourcing and management, commercial negotiations, contract and lease administration, PR-to-PO processing, spend analysis, and ensuring the timely procurement of goods and services in compliance with company procurement policies.

The ideal candidate should possess strong negotiation, analytical, stakeholder management, and coordination skills, along with a service-oriented approach and a keen eye for detail.

Key Responsibilities:

Administration Procurement:
- Manage procurement of office supplies, stationery, pantry items, and other administrative requirements.
- Coordinate procurement for facility management services, including housekeeping, security, pest control, and maintenance services.
- Source and procure office infrastructure such as furniture, workstations, printers, and related equipment.
- Track and manage Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMCs), ensuring timely renewals.
- Support procurement requirements for corporate events, employee engagement initiatives, and office activities.
- Coordinate travel and accommodation bookings in line with company policies.
- Ensure timely conversion of Purchase Requisitions (PRs) into Purchase Orders (POs).
- Maintain an updated vendor database and monitor vendor performance.
- Conduct cost comparisons and negotiate commercial terms within the approved authority limits.

Lease Rental Management:
- Manage procurement support for office spaces, branches, warehouses, fleet hubs, and other leased facilities.
- Collaborate with Business, Administration, Finance, and Legal teams for new lease acquisitions, renewals, amendments, and lease closures.
- Participate in commercial negotiations with landlords, property owners, and real estate consultants to secure competitive lease terms.
- Review lease proposals and ensure compliance with procurement policies and internal approval processes.
- Coordinate lease agreement execution and maintain trackers for lease expiries, renewals, rent escalations, security deposits, lock-in periods, and notice periods.
- Process lease-related PRs, POs (where applicable), rental invoices, and payment coordination.
- Monitor rental payments, Common Area Maintenance (CAM) charges, utility-related obligations, and other lease-associated commercial commitments.
- Maintain centralized lease documentation and ensure audit readiness.
- Identify opportunities for lease cost optimization through renegotiation, benchmarking, and space utilization initiatives.
- Coordinate with internal stakeholders and external landlords to resolve commercial and operational issues related to leased properties.

HR Procurement:
- Coordinate with employee benefits vendors, including Group Medical Cover (GMC) and Group Term Life (GTL) insurance providers.
- Support onboarding and management of Training & Development partners.
- Coordinate with recruitment agencies for billing, documentation, and vendor management.
- Manage background verification vendor coordination.
- Oversee procurement of employee onboarding kits, corporate gifting, and engagement materials.
- Support coordination with payroll and HRMS service providers.
- Track contract validity, renewals, and compliance for HR-related vendors.

Operational Responsibilities:
- Ensure compliance with procurement policies, governance standards, and approval workflows.
- Prepare comparative statements, vendor evaluations, commercial assessments, and sourcing recommendations.
- Monitor procurement timelines and proactively resolve vendor-related issues.
- Maintain procurement records and documentation to support audit and compliance requirements.
- Support budget monitoring, spend analysis, and cost optimization initiatives.
- Ensure timely contract renewals and drive effective vendor performance management.

Skills & Qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, or a related discipline.
- Minimum 6 years of procurement experience, with exposure to Administration, - Facility Management, HR, and Lease Rental procurement categories.
- Strong understanding of sourcing, commercial negotiations, procurement lifecycle (PR-to-PO), contract administration, and vendor management.
- Prior experience in lease commercial negotiations and lease agreement management will be an added advantage.
- Excellent analytical and commercial evaluation capabilities.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
- Strong negotiation, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
- High attention to detail with strong documentation and record management capabilities.
- Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and priorities while delivering high-quality procurement support.

We are looking for an Analytics and Tag Manager Implementation Specialist to join our digital marketing team. The ideal candidate will be passionate about web analytics, an expert in Google Tag Manager and possess strong Javascript skills. This professional will play a crucial role in improving our digital marketing strategies, ensuring the correct implementation of measurement and analytics tools.

Responsibilities:
1. Implement and maintain data tracking solutions using Google Tag Manager to ensure accurate
and complete data collection.
2. Collaborate closely with the marketing team to understand specific tracking objectives and
requirements.
3. Develop and maintain JavaScript scripts to customize and enhance data collection.
4. Set up and manage Google Analytics 4 to analyze campaign performance and user behavior.
5. Perform regular audits to ensure data integrity and troubleshoot tracking issues.
6. Collaborate with other teams to integrate analytics data into marketing reports and dashboards.

Requirements:
1. Demonstrated experience implementing and managing Google Tag Manager.
2. Advanced Javascript skills for tracking customization and troubleshooting.
3. Hands-on experience with Google Analytics 4, including event and goal configuration.
4. Deep understanding of digital marketing principles and the importance of analytics in digital
strategies.
5. Strong analytical skills and ability to translate data into actionable recommendations.
6. Excellent communication skills and ability to work in a team environment.

Role Overview  
The Area Collections Manager will be responsible for managing end-to-end collections across  bucket segments, driving resolution strategies, ensuring portfolio health, and leading large  on-ground and tele-calling teams. The role requires strong expertise in delinquency  management, compliance, analytics, and team leadership.

Key Responsibilities  
1. Bucket & Portfolio Management  
● Manage collections across delinquency buckets (0–30, 31–60, and higher DPD  segments)  
● Improve resolution rates in both early and late buckets  
● Focus on non-starter and delinquent accounts to prevent roll-forward  
● Drive collection efficiency and overall portfolio health  
● Monitor daily performance and ensure adherence to CAPE norms  

2. Tele-Collections Management  
● Handle soft delinquency buckets (0–30 & 31–60 DPD) through tele-calling strategies  
● Design and optimize calling patterns based on customer risk profiling  
● Improve dialer efficiency, call connect rates, and campaign performance  
● Maximize early-stage resolutions to prevent migration to hard buckets  

3. Field Collections & Risk Control  
● Ensure strong field discipline (app usage, visit tracking, audit trails)  
● Drive legal escalation for critical/high-risk cases  
● Conduct audits to identify and mitigate portfolio risks  
● Maintain strong governance and control mechanisms  

4. Team Leadership & Vendor Management  
● Lead large teams including Collection Managers, Team Leaders, and Executives  
● Manage third-party/vendor collection agencies  
● Allocate portfolios and set bucket-wise targets  
● Conduct daily huddles, reviews, and performance tracking  
● Coach teams on negotiation, objection handling, and resolution strategies  

5. Target Achievement & Performance Delivery  
● Drive monthly collection targets and improve resolution ratios  
● Enhance PTP (Promise to Pay) conversion and kept rates  
● Focus on First-Time Delinquent (FTD) customers to reduce future NPAs  
● Ensure productivity metrics such as calls, RPC (Right Party Contact), and CE% are met  

6. Compliance & Governance  
● Ensure strict adherence to RBI guidelines and regulatory standards  
● Handle escalations and customer grievances effectively  
● Maintain ethical and compliant recovery practices  
● Support internal and external audit requirements  

7. MIS, Analytics & Reporting  
● Track and analyze KPIs: CE%, RPC, PTP, dialer metrics, and resolution ratios  
● Manage large portfolio data and generate actionable insights  
● Identify gaps in collection strategies and recommend improvements  
● Present performance reports and insights to senior management.  

8. Key Skills & Competencies  
● Strong expertise in collections strategy (early & late buckets)  
● Proven leadership experience managing large teams and vendors  
● Analytical mindset with strong MIS and reporting skills  
● Knowledge of RBI regulations and compliance frameworks  
● Excellent communication, negotiation, and problem-solving skills  



● Ability to drive performance in high-pressure, target-driven environments

data.descriptionPlain:
About Us: 
Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytm's mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.
 
About the team: Liaison between the creditors and consumers. They are in charge of observing accounts to identify overdue payments, report collection activity, address client queries, and develop repayment plans.

About the role: Lead the collections target and control collection flow for specified area. Handle large team of collection officers, their productivity and performance.
 
Expectations/ Requirements:

1. To Achieve Collection targets of the area assigned, control flow cases and focus on non starters. 
2. Ensured documented feedback. 
3. Ensure Adequate feet on Street availability/bucket wise /segment wise. 
4. Manage productivity for fixing productivity parameters for Collection Officers Agencies/In-house team. 
5. Monitoring performance against set parameters and weekly review with Collection executives. 
6. Ensuring background check of all collection agencies hired/Identify and manage training needs of the Collection Executives/ Evaluation of performance of all CE. 
7. Support Collection officers in legal /Police issues/Collection Activities.
 
Superpowers/ Skills that will help you succeed in this role:
 
1. People Management Skills.
2. More than 5 years of relevant experience in Collections role.
3. Demonstrated Success and achievement orientation. 
4. Excellent Communication Skills. 
5. Negotiations skills - strong bias for driving results in a High performance environment. 
6. Strong Relationship and Leadership skills. 
7. Working Knowledge of Computers.

Education: 
Graduation/ Post Graduation preferred.

Why join us:
We support our people by providing a range of flexible working options so they can work in the way that best suits them. We also offer you the opportunity to develop your career, working in a diverse and inclusive workplace where the diverse backgrounds, perspectives and life experiences of our people are celebrated and create a great place to grow, thrive and belong. Most importantly, for us Work is Fun!!

Compensation:
If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you with enviable 500 mn+ registered users,21 mn+ merchants and depth of data in our ecosystem, we are in a unique position to democratize credit for deserving consumers & merchants – and we are committed to it. India’s largest digital lending story is brewing here. It’s your opportunity to be a part of the story! democratize credit for deserving consumers & merchants – and we are committed to it. India’s largest digital lending story is brewing here.

data.descriptionPlain:
About Us:   Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the  mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with  payments and commerce. Paytm’s mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the  mainstream economy with the help of technology.  

About the Team : The Merchant Lending team is one of the fastest-growing business verticals at Paytm, focused on enabling credit access to millions of merchants across India. The team drives credit penetration, loan lifecycle management, and cross-sell of high-value financial products like Gold SIP, Insurance, and other merchant-centric financial Solutions.

About the Role: Paytm is looking for an experienced Sales Leader & People Manager to drive the Merchant Lending business across the assigned region. The role involves scaling merchant loan penetration, strengthening underwriting funnel quality, and unlocking incremental revenue through strategic cross-sell initiatives. Expectations/ Requirements:

 1. Grow Merchant Lending penetration and overall credit distribution in the assigned geography. 
2.⁠Drive visibility & deployment of lending products—Merchant Loans, BNPL, QR-linked credit, overdraft lines, etc.
 3.⁠Lead cross-sell of financial products like Gold SIP, Insurance, and other merchant financial tools to enhance merchant stickiness and revenue-per-merchant. 
4.⁠Identify, recruit, and manage a strong field sales team to accelerate lending acquisition and cross-sell outputs. 5.⁠Define market size, span, funnel metrics, and territories for Team Leads to maximise efficiency. 
6.⁠Ensure seamless communication of plans/targets, minimising expectation vs delivery gaps.
 7.⁠Monitor and improve portfolio quality metrics—repayment behaviour, fraud checks, documentation hygiene, and onboarding quality. 
8.⁠Conduct audits and validations on loan files, sales processes, and cross-sell adherence. 
9.⁠Lead and mentor a large on-ground structure of 5–10 Team Leads & 100+ indirect employees, ensuring high productivity and compliance.

About Us: Paytm Money Limited is a SEBI registered Stockbroker and Depository Participant that offers
services related to Equity, Derivatives trading, Research Analyst & Distribution of financial products. It is a
fully owned subsidiary of One 97 Communications Limited, a listed entity in NSE and BSE. Paytm is
India’s largest digital payment app which makes it secure and seamless to pay using UPI, make bill
payments, recharge mobiles, DTH, data card &amp; Metro Card etc anywhere in India.

Key Responsibilities:
● Monitoring Surveillance activities – trade as well as Name Screening.
● Assist in Compliance regulatory change implementation through a sophisticated Compliance
Tool.
● Conduct regular compliance audits and assessments to identify potential risks and areas for
improvement within surveillance function.
● Prepare and submit regulatory filings, reports, and documentation as required by SEBI.
● Collaborate with internal teams to gather necessary information for compliance reviews and
audits.
● Maintain accurate records of compliance activities and findings.
● Support the senior compliance team in conducting investigations into compliance breaches and
implementing corrective actions.

Qualifications:
● Bachelor’s degree in Commerce, Finance, Business Administration, Law, or a related field with
minimum 4-5 years of experience
● Familiarity with SEBI regulations and compliance requirements.
● Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.
● Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
● Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint).
Preferred Skills:
● Previous experience in compliance and /or Surveillance Function.
● Knowledge of financial markets and investment products.

Reporting:
The incumbent will be reporting to SM - Compliance

Roles & Responsibilities:  
Build a Creator-Led Affiliate Model 
 • Identify and shortlist regional content creators, micro-influencers, YouTubers and  Instagram creators to participate in an affiliate program where we pay the creator on every  new user acquisition.  
• Research creators through the internet, social media platforms, YouTube, Instagram and  local content pages.  
• Build creator lists by language, city, category, audience type and performance potential.  
• Reach out to creators through email, WhatsApp, Instagram DM and calls.  
• Coordinate with creators for briefs, timelines, content posting, tracking links and  performance reports.  
• Maintain and update creator data in Excel or Google Sheets, including status updates and  campaign reports.  
• Track creator-wise daily performance across views, clicks, installs, payments and cost per  acquired user. 
 • Recommend creators based on business impact, not just follower count.  
• Share weekly updates on creator outreach, onboarding, content posted and results  delivered.  

What We Are Looking For:  
• Fluency in the assigned language.  
• Good understanding of regional content, creators and local culture. 
 • An existing creator network is useful, but not mandatory.  
• Ability to research creators independently on the internet.  
• Comfort with email, WhatsApp, Excel, Google Sheets and basic reporting.  
• Experience is not mandatory. Freshers can also apply.  
• A quick learner who is self-driven and able to deliver monthly targets.

Role Summary:To support the Company Secretary in ensuring compliance with the Companies Act, 2013, Secretarial Standards, and other applicable laws, while assisting in corporate governance, statutory filings, and board-related matters.

Key Responsibilities:
- Support the Company Secretary in conducting Board, Committee, and Shareholders' Meetings, including preparation of notices, agendas, minutes, and resolutions.
- Assist in maintaining statutory registers, records, and corporate documents.
- Support timely filing of forms, returns, and other documents with the Registrar of Companies (ROC) and other regulatory authorities.
- Assist in monitoring compliance with the Companies Act, 2013, Secretarial Standards, and internal governance requirements.
- Coordinate with internal departments, auditors, consultants, and regulatory authorities for compliance-related matters.
- Support secretarial audits, due diligence exercises, and closure of compliance observations.
- Assist in drafting corporate documents, policies, and regulatory submissions.
- Track statutory and regulatory changes and support implementation of compliance requirements.

Qualifications & Experience:
- Qualified Company Secretary (ICSI Member)
- Post-qualification experience of 2–3 years in corporate secretarial and compliance functions.
Preference will be given to candidates with experience in an Unlisted Public Company.

Skills Required:
- Good knowledge of the Companies Act, 2013, Secretarial Standards, and MCA compliances.
- Strong drafting and documentation skills.
- Proficiency in MCA filings, Compliance Tools, Board PAC and MS Office applications.
- Good communication, coordination, and organizational skills.

About Paytm:

Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytm’s mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.

About the Team:
 The Compliance department has five areas of responsibility—identification,
prevention, monitoring and detection, resolution, and advisory for the entity with respect to regulations/ laws, and is part of the enterprise compliance group at Paytm.

About the role: This role will focus on advising business and overseeing compliance-related matters in the company. The role entails advising in terms of the relevant regulatory expectations to the respective business units and ensuring timely monitoring and detection of compliance-related issues.

Expectations/ Requirements:
1) Oversee and monitor adherence to applicable laws and regulations in the domains of digital lending, offline payments aggregators, BBPS, and UPI TPAP segments.
2) Provide informed compliance opinions to the internal stakeholders on the applicability of regulatory laws and guidelines.
3) Assess compliance and regulatory risks associated with business activities and ensure effective risk management strategies are in place.
4) Collaborate closely and creatively with cross-functional teams to guide the seamless implementation of regulatory guidelines and compliance requirements.

Engineering Manager - Backend 

About Us: 
Paytm is India’s leading digital payments and financial services company, which is focused on driving consumers and merchants to its platform by offering them a variety of payment use cases. To merchants, Paytm offers acquiring devices like Soundbox, EDC, QR and Payment Gateway where payment aggregation is done through PPI and also other banks’ financial instruments. To further enhance merchants’ business, Paytm offers merchants commerce services through advertising and Paytm Mini app store. Operating on this platform leverage, the company then offers credit services such as merchant loans, personal loans and BNPL, sourced by its financial partners.  

About the role:
As a  Engineering Manager, you will help define the technical design and implementation roadmap across multiple solutions and will work with engineering leadership to ensure we resource and equip our squads with the right expertise to deliver those solutions.  

Requirements: 
8 to 12 years of strong software design/development experience in building massively large scale distributed internet systems and products
Hands on experience in Advance Java, Spring boot, AWS, Node, Agentic AI, LLM, RAG, Cursor, Copilot
Experience and knowledge of open source tools & frameworks, broader cutting edge technologies around server side development
Should be an active contributor to developer communities like Stack overflow, Top coder, Git hub, Google Developer Groups (GDGs). 
Superior organization, communication, interpersonal and leadership skills.
Must be a self-starter who can work well with minimal guidance and in fluid environment. 

Preferred Qualifications : Bachelor's/Master's Degree in Computer Science or equivalent 

Skills that will help you succeed in this role: 
Expertise in Java, DB: RDBMS, Messaging: Kafka/RabbitMQ, Caching: Redis/Aerospike, Micro services, AWS
Strong experience in scaling, performance tuning & optimization at both API and storage layers
Problem Solver with a passion for excellence.  

Why join us:
Because you get an opportunity to make a difference, and have a great time doing that
You are challenged and encouraged here to do stuff that is meaningful for you and for those we serve
You should work with us if you think seriously about what technology can do for people
We are successful, and our successes are rooted in our people's collective energy and unwavering focus on the customer, and that's how it will always be. 
Learn more about the exciting work we do in Tech by reading our Engineering blogs

Compensation:
If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you.

About the Role:
We are looking for a highly analytical and data-driven Business Analyst who can derive  actionable insights to support business growth, product strategy, and operational efficiency. The  ideal candidate should have strong problem-solving abilities, hands-on experience with SQL  and Power BI, and the ability to work closely with cross-functional teams to drive data-backed  decision making.  

Key Responsibilities:

● Build and maintain dashboards, MIS reports, and business performance trackers using  Power BI.

● Partner with business, product, marketing, and operations teams to support strategic  initiatives.  
● Monitor key business metrics and provide actionable recommendations to stakeholders.  
● Automate recurring reports and improve reporting efficiency.  
● Present insights and findings to leadership teams in a clear and structured manner.  

Requirements:

● Strong proficiency in SQL and Power BI is mandatory.  
● Good understanding of data visualization, reporting, and dashboarding.  
● Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.  
● Experience working with large datasets and deriving business insights.  
● Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.  
● Prior experience in fintech, consumer internet, or digital businesses will be preferred.  

Preferred Skills:
● Knowledge of Excel, Python, or other analytics tools is a plus.  
● Exposure to product analytics, customer lifecycle analysis, or performance marketing  analytics would be an advantage.

Paytm’s mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with  the help of  technology. 

About the role: 
We're looking for a Business Finance Manager for our central business finance team. You'll be a key part of our success by: 
- Analyzing financial performance to find areas for improvement and growth opportunities.
-Working closely with business and finance teams to understand the factors that influence results.
-Providing data-driven insights to the Business Heads and Finance leadership to support effective decision-making.
-Monitoring progress towards goals and proactively addressing potential risks.

Expectations/ Requirements: 
What You'll Do:
- Collaborate closely with Business, participating actively in their strategic planning.
- Develop detailed financial plans, using a bottom-up approach to ensure accuracy and buy-in.
- Regularly analyze actual results against the plan, identify the reasons for any variances, and clearly communicate your findings to facilitate informed decision-making.
- Track and report on key financial and business metrics
- Contribute to the unit's goal-setting process and create a detailed annual operating plan to achieve those goals.
- Ensure the accuracy and completeness of month-end financial reports, including reviews, procedures, and necessary corrections.
- Contribute to the improvement of financial processes, including revenue cycle activities, to optimize efficiency and effectiveness.
- Analyze the financial impact of potential new products or business initiatives and present your findings to senior management.
- Respond promptly to requests for information and problem-solving, providing thorough analysis and insights to support decision-making.
- Actively participate in projects aimed at standardizing and automating processes to improve efficiency.

Superpowers/ Skills that will help you succeed in this role:
- 7+ years in a Business Finance role.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify trends and insights from complex data.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to explain financial information clearly to both financial and non-financial audiences.
- Advanced skills in MS Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint, to effectively analyze and present data.
- Ability to take initiative and work independently.

Why join us
1.  A collaborative output driven program that brings cohesiveness across businesses through technology
2.  Improve the average revenue per use by increasing the cross-sell opportunities
3.  A solid 360 feedback from your peer teams on your support of their goals
4. Respect, that is earned, not demanded from your peers and manager
 
Compensation:
If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you
With enviable 500 mn+ registered users, 21 mn+ merchants and depth of data in our ecosystem, we are in a unique position to democratize credit for deserving consumers & merchants – and we are committed to it. India’s largest digital lending story is brewing here. It’s your opportunity to be a part of the story!

Title: Business Head - Equity

About Us: Paytm is India's leading digital payments and financial services company. Our platform offers a wide range of payment solutions to consumers and merchants, including utility payments, money transfers, and Paytm Payment Instruments (PPI) such as Paytm Wallet, Paytm UPI, and Paytm Payments Bank Net-Banking. We also provide merchant services, advertising, and a Mini app store. With a focus on growth and engagement, we leverage data science to drive sustainable success. We offer credit services sourced from financial partners to further support merchants.

About the Role:We are looking for a growth-oriented and data-driven professional to drive user acquisition, activation, and retention for Intraday Trading and IPO businesses at Paytm Money. The role requires strong analytical thinking, campaign management capabilities, and collaboration across product, marketing, and analytics teams to improve user engagement and business growth.  

Key Responsibilities: Business Growth & Ownership. Own and drive Monthly Transacting Users (MTUs) across all Equity products including Delivery, Intraday, ETFs, IPOs, Trading Ideas, Baskets, Bonds, NPS, and SIPs. Define and execute business strategies to drive user acquisition, activation, engagement, and retention across the Equity ecosystem. Identify growth opportunities and build initiatives to increase market share in the cash segment.
Product Strategy & Roadmap. Develop product vision and business roadmaps for Equity products. Partner closely with Product and Technology teams to prioritize, build, and launch features that drive customer growth and business outcomes. Monitor product performance, customer behavior, and market trends to continuously refine the roadmap.
Go-to-Market (GTM) & Customer Growth: Design and execute GTM strategies for new product launches, feature rollouts, and business initiatives. Collaborate with Marketing, CRM, and Growth teams to maximize adoption and engagement across channels. Drive customer education and awareness initiatives to improve product penetration and trading activity. 
Analytics & Business Strategy: Work closely with Analytics teams to derive actionable insights from customer and business data. Build data-driven growth strategies and performance frameworks to track key business metrics. Own business reviews, growth reporting, forecasting, and leadership updates. 
Team Leadership: Lead, mentor, and develop the Equity Business team. Set clear goals, drive execution excellence, and build a high-performance culture. Collaborate effectively with cross-functional stakeholders to ensure alignment on business priorities and outcomes.

Who We're Looking For: 10–15+ years of experience in Equity, Broking, Wealth Management, Fintech, or Capital Markets businesses. Strong understanding of equity investing products, trading behavior, and retail investor ecosystems. Proven track record of driving business growth, customer engagement, and revenue outcomes at scale. Experience working closely with Product, Marketing, Analytics, and Technology teams. Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with a data-driven decision-making approach. Demonstrated leadership experience managing high-performing teams. Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and strategic planning skills. MBA from a reputed institution or equivalent experience preferred.

Why join us:We give immense opportunities to make a difference and have a great time doing that.You are challenged and encouraged here to do meaning work for yourself and customers/clientsWe are successful, and our successes are rooted in our people's collective energy and unwavering focus on the customer, and that's how it will always beWith over 500 million+ registered users, 35 million+ merchants, and a wealth of data in our ecosystem, we are uniquely positioned to democratize credit and shape India's largest digital lending and payments story.

About the Role: Paytm Money is looking for a dynamic and entrepreneurial General Manager – Business Head, ETF to lead and scale our Exchange Traded Funds business. This role will own the complete ETF charter including business strategy, product growth, customer acquisition, partnerships, monetization, and market expansion, with the objective of building Paytm Money into India’s leading ETF investment platform. This is a high-impact leadership role for someone who deeply understands capital markets, passive investing, brokerage ecosystems, and retail investor behavior, and can translate market opportunities into scalable business outcomes.

Key Responsibilities:
Business Ownership & Strategy
* Own the end-to-end P&L for the ETF business
* Define and execute Paytm Money’s ETF growth roadmap
* Identify opportunities across equity ETFs, thematic ETFs, sectoral ETFs, debt ETFs, commodity ETFs, and global ETFs
* Build long-term strategy for ETF adoption and passive investing growth

Growth & Customer Acquisition
* Drive ETF user acquisition, activation, and retention
* Build investor journeys for first-time ETF investors and active traders
* Design customer growth strategies across app, digital channels, and partnerships
* Improve ETF discovery, conversion, and repeat investment behavior

Title: Business Head – F&O

About Us

Paytm is India's leading digital payments and financial services company. Our platform offers a wide range of payment solutions to consumers and merchants, including utility payments, money transfers, and Paytm Payment Instruments (PPI) such as Paytm Wallet, Paytm UPI, and Paytm Payments Bank Net-Banking. We also provide merchant services, advertising, and a Mini app store. With a focus on growth and engagement, we leverage data science to drive sustainable success. We offer credit services sourced from financial partners to further support merchants.

About the Role

We are looking for a highly driven Business Head – F&O to lead the Futures & Options business for Paytm Money. This role will own the F&O business strategy, P&L, product roadmap, growth initiatives, and customer lifecycle. You will work closely with Product, Growth, Analytics, Risk, Compliance, and Operations teams to drive business growth, improve trader engagement, and strengthen Paytm Money's position in the derivatives market.
Responsibilities
Own the F&O business P&L and drive key business metrics including MTUs, retention, premium turnover market share, and ARPU.
Define and execute growth strategies across acquisition, activation, engagement, and retention of F&O traders.
Partner with Product teams to build the F&O roadmap, including order types, margin products, trader tools, pricing, and analytics.
Drive lifecycle marketing and engagement initiatives to improve trader activation, retention, and wallet share.
Monitor business performance through dashboards, metrics, and experiment-led decision making.
Track competition, market trends, and SEBI/exchange regulations to adapt business strategies.
Collaborate with Risk, Compliance, Customer Support, and Operations teams to deliver a seamless, compliant, and high-trust trading experience.
Work closely with cross-functional stakeholders to execute strategic initiatives and achieve business growth targets.

Expectations / Requirements

5+ years of experience in the stock broking industry with strong expertise in the F&O/Derivatives business.
Deep understanding of options, futures, margining, trader behavior, and Indian market structure.
Experience in Product Management, Business Management, Growth, or Product Marketing within the broking or fintech ecosystem.
Proven track record of driving business metrics such as MTUs, retention, premium turnover, ARPU, or revenue growth.
Strong analytical skills with experience in business reporting, cohort analysis, experimentation, and data-driven decision making.
Good understanding of the Indian broking landscape, discount brokerage models, and SEBI regulations.
Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and execution skills.
Active F&O trading experience will be an added advantage.

Education

Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Engineering, or a related field. MBA is preferred.

Why Join Us
Build and scale one of India's fastest-growing F&O businesses.
Own the strategy and execution of a high-impact business vertical.
Work alongside talented teams across Product, Engineering, Growth, Risk, and Analytics.
Be part of an organization shaping the future of investing and wealth creation for millions of Indians.
Compensation
We offer competitive compensation reflecting your contribution. If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you.
If you're ready to build and scale the future of derivatives trading at Paytm Money, we'd love to hear from you!

About Paytm Group: Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytm's mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology. 

About the Role: Paytm Money is looking for a strategic and growth-driven Business Head – Mutual Funds & NFO to lead one of the most critical charters within our wealth business. This role will own the complete Mutual Fund and New Fund Offer (NFO) business, including business strategy, product growth, partnerships, customer acquisition, revenue acceleration, platform innovation, and market expansion. The ideal leader will bring deep expertise in mutual fund distribution, passive and active investment products, investor behavior, AMC partnerships, and digital wealth ecosystems, while building a scalable business that democratizes investing for millions of Indians. This is not just a distribution leadership role. It is an opportunity to define the next phase of retail investing by building India’s most intelligent, accessible, and high-growth MF platform.

Key Responsibilities:
1. Business Ownership & P&L Leadership
* Own end-to-end P&L for the Mutual Funds and NFO business 
* Define annual and long-term growth strategy 
* Drive topline growth, profitability, customer expansion, and AUM scale
* Build category growth roadmap across: Equity Mutual Funds, Debt Funds, Hybrid Funds, Index Funds, ETFs, International Funds, Thematic / Sectoral Funds

2. NFO Strategy & Execution
* Lead the complete NFO business charter
* Identify high-potential fund launches and build GTM strategy
* Drive subscription volumes across marquee NFO launches
* Partner with AMCs for exclusive campaigns and launches
* Build strong investor education and conversion funnels around NFO participation

3. Growth & Customer Acquisition
* Drive MF investor acquisition at scale
* Improve SIP activation, repeat investment behavior, and retention
* Design high-conversion journeys for: First-time investors, Passive investors, Existing equity users cross-selling into MF
* Build lifecycle programs to improve customer stickiness

4. Product & Platform Innovation
* Partner closely with Product and Engineering to build category-leading investment experiences including: SIP innovation, Goal-based investing journeys, Fund recommendation engines, Portfolio insights, Smart asset allocation tools, Risk profiling frameworks & MF comparison and discovery experience

5. AMC & Ecosystem Partnerships
* Build and strengthen strategic relationships with: Leading Asset Management Companies, Registrar & Transfer Agents, Market infrastructure partners, Distribution ecosystem stakeholders, Drive commercial partnerships, co-marketing opportunities, and exclusive launches.

6. Analytics & Business Intelligence
* Own metrics across: AUM growth, SIP book expansion, Investor activation, NFO conversion, Redemption trends, Retention and cohort behavior
* Leverage analytics to build sharper acquisition and monetization strategies.

7. Market Intelligence & Competitive Strategy
* Track industry shifts across: Passive investing trends, Regulatory developments, Competitor product innovation, Investor behavior evolution 
* Translate insights into business opportunities.

8. Team Leadership
* Build and lead high-performing teams across: Business, Partnerships, Growth, Category management, Analytics
* Create a culture of speed, ownership, and customer obsession.

What We’re Looking For:
* Experience - 12–18 years of experience in: Wealth-tech, Broking, Mutual fund distribution, Asset management& Consumer fintech

Domain Expertise:
* Deep understanding of: Mutual fund ecosystem, SIP and systematic investing behavior, NFO lifecycle and GTM, Distribution economics, Retail investor acquisition, Capital markets and investment products

Leadership Capabilities: 
* Strong business ownership mindset
* P&L management
* Strategic thinking with execution excellence
* Cross-functional influence
* Data-driven decision making

Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytm's mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology. 

About the Role: Paytm Money is looking for a strategic and growth-driven Business Head – Mutual Funds & NFO to lead one of the most critical charters within our wealth business. This role will own the complete Mutual Fund and New Fund Offer (NFO) business, including business strategy, product growth, partnerships, customer acquisition, revenue acceleration, platform innovation, and market expansion. The ideal leader will bring deep expertise in mutual fund distribution, passive and active investment products, investor behavior, AMC partnerships, and digital wealth ecosystems, while building a scalable business that democratizes investing for millions of Indians. This is not just a distribution leadership role. It is an opportunity to define the next phase of retail investing by building India’s most intelligent, accessible, and high-growth MF platform.

Key Responsibilities:
1. Business Ownership & P&L Leadership
* Own end-to-end P&L for the Mutual Funds and NFO business 
* Define annual and long-term growth strategy 
* Drive topline growth, profitability, customer expansion, and AUM scale
* Build category growth roadmap across: Equity Mutual Funds, Debt Funds, Hybrid Funds, Index Funds, ETFs, International Funds, Thematic / Sectoral Funds

2. NFO Strategy & Execution
* Lead the complete NFO business charter
* Identify high-potential fund launches and build GTM strategy
* Drive subscription volumes across marquee NFO launches
* Partner with AMCs for exclusive campaigns and launches
* Build strong investor education and conversion funnels around NFO participation

3. Growth & Customer Acquisition
* Drive MF investor acquisition at scale
* Improve SIP activation, repeat investment behavior, and retention
* Design high-conversion journeys for: First-time investors, Passive investors, Existing equity users cross-selling into MF
* Build lifecycle programs to improve customer stickiness

4. Product & Platform Innovation
* Partner closely with Product and Engineering to build category-leading investment experiences including: SIP innovation, Goal-based investing journeys, Fund recommendation engines, Portfolio insights, Smart asset allocation tools, Risk profiling frameworks & MF comparison and discovery experience

5. AMC & Ecosystem Partnerships
* Build and strengthen strategic relationships with: Leading Asset Management Companies, Registrar & Transfer Agents, Market infrastructure partners, Distribution ecosystem stakeholders, Drive commercial partnerships, co-marketing opportunities, and exclusive launches.

6. Analytics & Business Intelligence
* Own metrics across: AUM growth, SIP book expansion, Investor activation, NFO conversion, Redemption trends, Retention and cohort behavior
* Leverage analytics to build sharper acquisition and monetization strategies.

7. Market Intelligence & Competitive Strategy
* Track industry shifts across: Passive investing trends, Regulatory developments, Competitor product innovation, Investor behavior evolution 
* Translate insights into business opportunities.

8. Team Leadership
* Build and lead high-performing teams across: Business, Partnerships, Growth, Category management, Analytics
* Create a culture of speed, ownership, and customer obsession.

What We’re Looking For:
* Experience - 12–18 years of experience in: Wealth-tech, Broking, Mutual fund distribution, Asset management& Consumer fintech

Domain Expertise:
* Deep understanding of: Mutual fund ecosystem, SIP and systematic investing behavior, NFO lifecycle and GTM, Distribution economics, Retail investor acquisition, Capital markets and investment products

Leadership Capabilities: 
* Strong business ownership mindset
* P&L management
* Strategic thinking with execution excellence
* Cross-functional influence
* Data-driven decision making

About Us:  Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytm’s mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.

Job Summary:
We are seeking a diligent and detail-oriented Audit and Compliance Operations Executive to join our Collection Unit. The ideal candidate will play a crucial role in ensuring that all collection processes adhere to regulatory requirements, organizational policies, and industry standards. This position involves monitoring, auditing, and providing insights to enhance compliance and operational efficiency while minimizing risk. The Compromise Settlement Process Operation Executive will manage and oversee the end-to-end compromise settlement process within the collection unit. This role ensures timely, efficient, and complaint resolution of settlement cases while balancing recovery goals and customer experience. The executive will act as a liaison between internal teams and external stakeholders

Key Responsibilities:

Settlement
1. Process Management:
Manage the end-to-end compromise settlement process, including case identification, evaluation, approval, and closure.
Ensure all settlements are processed in line with internal policies, regulatory guidelines, and delegated authorities.
Maintain detailed and accurate records of all settlement negotiations and decisions.
2. Case Evaluation and Approval:
Assess customer accounts and validate settlement offers based on financial viability and recovery strategies.
Prepare detailed proposals and seek necessary approvals in accordance with the Delegation of Approval (DOA) framework.
Ensure adherence to established approval limits and escalate cases requiring higher-level authorizations to relevant authorities.
Monitor and ensure timely decision-making within the DOA hierarchy to maintain process efficiency.
4. Reporting and Documentation:
Prepare regular reports on settlement cases, recovery achieved, and operational efficiency.
Maintain an audit trail for all settlement transactions to ensure compliance and accountability.
5. Cross-functional Coordination:
Work closely with collection managers, legal teams, and compliance officers to ensure smooth execution of settlements.
Liaise with cross-functional team, Lenders, Collection team and vendors or third-party agencies involved in the compromise settlement process.
6. Compliance and Risk Management:
Adhere to all regulatory requirements and internal policies related to collections and compromise settlements.
Identify potential risks in the settlement process and escalate issues to senior management when necessary.
7. Continuous Improvement:
Recommend process improvements to enhance settlement efficiency and recovery rates.
Stay updated on industry trends and best practices in compromise settlements and collections.

Audit and Monitoring:
Conduct regular audits of collection activities, ensuring adherence to internal policies, regulatory guidelines, and industry best practices.
Review collection documentation, processes, and systems for accuracy and compliance.
Monitor agent performance and compliance with scripts, escalation protocols, and customer interaction guidelines.
Compliance Management:
Ensure the collection unit complies with applicable laws and regulations (e.g., consumer protection, data privacy, and fair debt collection).
Identify non-compliance risks and recommend corrective actions.
Collaborate with regulatory bodies during inspections and audits as required.
Process Improvement:
Analyze audit findings and provide actionable recommendations to enhance operational efficiency and compliance.
Develop and implement standard operating procedures (SOPs) to ensure robust compliance frameworks.
Participate in creating or updating policies to address emerging compliance challenges.
Vendor and Third-Party Oversight:
Conduct audits of third-party collection agencies to ensure alignment with organizational and regulatory standards.
Review vendor reports and compliance metrics, escalating deviations to management.
Customer Complaints and Incident Management:
Investigate and resolve escalated customer complaints related to collections.
Identify trends in complaints and propose measures to mitigate future occurrences.
Ensure timely reporting of compliance-related incidents and follow through on resolutions.
Reporting and Documentation:
Prepare detailed audit reports, compliance assessments, and performance reviews for management.
Maintain accurate records of audits, corrective actions, and compliance activities.

Why Join Us:
1.  A collaborative output driven program that brings cohesiveness across businesses through technology 
2.  Improve the average revenue per use by increasing the cross-sell opportunities
3.  A solid 360 feedback from your peer teams on your support of their goals
4.  Respect, that is earned, not demanded from your peers and manager

Compensation : If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you
With enviable 500 mn+ registered users, 21 mn+ merchants and depth of data in our ecosystem, we are in a unique position to democratize credit for deserving consumers & merchants – and we are committed to it. India’s largest digital lending story is brewing here. It’s your opportunity to be a part of the story!

About the Role:

We are seeking a Business Operations Manager to drive end-to-end operations for our Telecom Value-Added Services (VAS) business. The role will be responsible for ensuring seamless execution of telecom operations, managing operator relationships, coordinating with cross-functional teams, and driving operational excellence across business initiatives.

Key Responsibilities:

- Own and manage end-to-end business operations for Telecom VAS products and services.
- Act as the primary point of contact for telecom operator partners and ensure smooth execution of day-to-day operations.
- Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders across telecom operators and internal teams.
- Monitor operational performance, identify issues proactively, and drive timely resolution.
- Coordinate with Product, Technology, Content, Finance, and other cross-functional teams to ensure seamless service delivery.
- Manage operator onboarding, service launches, and ongoing operational requirements.
- Track business KPIs, prepare operational reports, and provide actionable insights to leadership.
- Drive process improvements to enhance operational efficiency and customer experience.
- Ensure adherence to SLAs, governance frameworks, and business commitments.
- Support revenue growth initiatives by working closely with business and partnership teams.

Qualifications & Experience:

- Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Telecommunications, or a related field.
- 7+ years of overall experience with at least 3 years of relevant experience in Telecom VAS, Telecom Operations, Business Operations, or Account Management.
- Proven experience in managing telecom operator relationships and business operations.
- Strong understanding of Telecom Value-Added Services (CRBT, Digital Content, Subscription Services, or related telecom products).
- Experience working with multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced business environment.

Required Skills:

- Business Operations ManagementTelecom VAS Domain Knowledge
- Stakeholder & Client Management
- Account ManagementService Delivery & Operations Excellence
- Problem Solving & Analytical Thinking
- Cross-functional Collaboration
- Reporting & Performance Monitoring
- Excellent Communication and Relationship Management Skills

Preferred Experience:

- Experience working with telecom operators and managing operator-led business initiatives.
- Exposure to CRBT and other digital telecom service ecosystems.
- Experience handling large-scale operational programs and business-critical deployments.

What Success Looks Like:

- Smooth and efficient execution of telecom business operations.
- Strong stakeholder relationships and operator satisfaction.
- Timely delivery of operational commitments and service launches.
- Continuous improvement in operational performance and business outcomes.

About Us – Paytm is India's payment Super App offering consumers and merchants most comprehensive payment services. Pioneer of mobile QR payments revolution in India, today, Paytm is India’s largest payment company by Users, Merchants, Payment Transactions and Revenue. Paytm’s mission is to drive financial inclusion in India and bring half a billion Indians into the mainstream economy through technology-led financial Services. Paytm enables commerce for small merchants and distributes various financial services offerings to its consumers and merchants in partnership with financial institutions. 
Paytm has been a pioneer in the merchant space by introducing innovative solutions like QR codes to accept payments and Sound-box to recon payments by voice alerts. We are also distributing loans to these partners 5via our ‘Paytm for Business’ App.

Key Responsibilities
🔹 Manage and strengthen strategic partnerships with insurance companies to drive business growth and profitability.
🔹 Lead commercial discussions on commissions, pricing, product offerings, and exclusive partnership opportunities.
🔹 Monitor insurer performance, identify growth opportunities, and drive improvement initiatives.
🔹 Collaborate with insurers on product development, integrations, and go-to-market strategies.
🔹 Partner closely with Product, Technology, Sales, and Marketing teams to execute business objectives.
🔹 Ensure compliance with IRDAI regulations, partnership agreements, and internal governance standards.
🔹 Prepare business reviews and present partnership performance, insights, and recommendations to leadership.

Qualifications and Experience: Bachelor/MBA or equivalent qualification from a reputable institution. 2-3 years of experience in insurance partnership management, business development, or product management roles into Health Insurance Domain. Strong negotiation, analytical, and stakeholder management skills. In-depth knowledge of the Indian insurance market and IRDAI regulatory environment.

About Us:
Paytm is India’s leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company and a pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution. Paytm builds technologies that empower small businesses with payments and commerce solutions. Our mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them into the mainstream economy through technology.

About the team:
Paytm Loyalty & Rewards is a B2B engagement and retention platform that enables enterprises to acquire, engage, and retain customers, partners, and employees through data-driven loyalty programs.
The team builds and manages end-to-end solutions including loyalty infrastructure (points, cashback, tiers, gamification), a large rewards marketplace (vouchers, travel, merchandise, experiences), and campaign engines (cashback offers, referrals, scratch cards). It also powers incentive programs for sales teams, dealers, and employees, with seamless digital fulfilment via Paytm Wallet, UPI, and vouchers.
Serving brands across FMCG, banking, fintech, telecom, and e-commerce, the team helps drive customer lifetime value, repeat engagement, and measurable business outcomes through scalable, tech-led loyalty solutions.

About the Role:
We are seeking results-driven and relationship-oriented candidates to drive strategic partnerships in the loyalty and rewards ecosystem. The role involves identifying, negotiating, and onboarding brands, merchants, and corporate partners to expand our loyalty program offerings, enhance member engagement, and drive incremental revenue.

Key Responsibilities:
Partnership & Acquisition
Identify and target potential partners across industries (FMCG, retail, travel, e-commerce, BFSI, hospitality, etc.) for loyalty tie-ups. 
Pitch the value proposition of our loyalty solutions and negotiate win–win partnership agreements. 
Build multi-sector partner portfolios to enhance member redemption and earning opportunities. 

Account Management & Relationship Building
Manage key partner accounts to ensure satisfaction, retention, and growth. 
Collaborate with partners on co-branded campaigns, joint promotions, and customer engagement initiatives. 
Track partner performance and recommend optimization strategies. 

Market Research & Strategy
Conduct competitor analysis, industry trend monitoring, and opportunity mapping in the loyalty space. 
Work with product and marketing teams to align partner offerings with customer needs and company goals. 

Revenue & KPI Management
Deliver on sales and partnership acquisition targets. 
Ensure partner deals contribute to incremental revenue, customer acquisition, and engagement KPIs. 

Required Skills & Qualifications:

Education: Bachelor’s degree (MBA preferred) in Business, Marketing, or related field. 

Experience: 3–7 years in business partnerships (preferably in loyalty programs, rewards platforms, fintech, CRM, brand alliances, brand marketing, or allied sectors). Proven track record of closing B2B deals and managing partner portfolios. 

Skills: Strong negotiation, presentation, and networking abilities. Understanding of loyalty program mechanics, reward redemption models, and partnership monetization. Ability to work cross-functionally with product, marketing, and analytics teams. Proficient in MS Office and CRM tools. 

Key Attributes:
Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for partnerships. 
Strong communication and interpersonal skills. 
Ability to work in a target-driven, fast-paced environment. 
Analytical thinking with data-driven decision-making capabilities. 

KPIs
 Number of new partnerships signed. 
 Partner revenue contribution to overall loyalty program. 
 Customer engagement and redemption rates driven by partner offers. 
 Retention and satisfaction scores of existing partners.  

Why Join Paytm:
At Paytm, our mission is to bring half a billion Indians into the mainstream economy through innovative financial technology solutions. Our success is driven by our people’s collective energy and an unwavering focus on our customers and merchants. Today, Paytm is India’s largest merchant acquirer and one of the leading fintech companies, powering millions of businesses across the country.

About Us: 

Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile QR  payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce.  Paytm’s mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of  technology.  

Location- Noida / Bangalore / Mumbai 

 Role Overview :

The Campaign Operations Specialist will be responsible for end-to-end execution and optimization of advertiser  campaigns on the Paytm Ads platform. This role sits at the intersection of ad operations, performance  optimization, and client delivery, ensuring campaigns run flawlessly, meet KPIs, and drive measurable business  outcomes.  

Key Responsibilities  

Campaign Setup & Execution 
 ● Set up and launch managed service ad campaigns across Paytm ad inventory (primarily scratch cards).  
● Configure targeting, budgets, bidding, creatives, and flighting based on client briefs. 
● Ensure accurate tagging, tracking, and attribution setup. 

 Campaign Monitoring & Optimization  
● Monitor live campaigns for delivery, pacing, CTR, CVR, ROAS, and CPA.  
● Perform ongoing optimizations on bids, targeting, creatives, and budgets to maximize performance.  
● Identify and resolve delivery issues (under-delivery, drop in CTR, tracking gaps).  
● Translate learnings into repeatable playbooks and SOPs. 

 Reporting & Insights 
● Prepare daily, weekly, and post-campaign reports for advertisers and internal stakeholders.  
● Analyze performance trends and convert data into actionable insights and recommendations.  
● Support QBRs and performance reviews with clear narratives and data storytelling.  

Client & Internal Collaboration  
● Act as the operations SPOC for sales, account management, and product teams.  
● Work closely with Sales to understand client objectives and translate them into executable media plans.  
● Coordinate with creative, tech, and product teams to resolve issues and improve campaign outcomes. 

 Platform & Process Excellence  
● Maintain high operational accuracy with zero-defect campaign launches.  
● Follow standard operating procedures while contributing to process improvements and automation. 
● Provide feedback on advertiser needs to help evolve Paytm Ads products and tools.  

Key Metrics You’ll Own  

● Campaign delivery & pacing accuracy, SLA adherence  
● CTR, CVR, CPA / ROAS improvement at account and portfolio levels  
● Client satisfaction & SLA adherence  
● Error-free campaign launches  

Required Qualifications  

● 2–6 years of experience in Ad Operations / Campaign Management / Performance Marketing.  
● Hands-on experience with managed service campaigns on ad platforms (e.g., Google Ads, Meta, Amazon  Ads, Flipkart Ads, Fintech Ad Platforms) and MMPs (Appsflyer, Adjust etc.)  
● Strong understanding of digital advertising metrics and optimization levers.  
● Advanced working knowledge of Excel / Google Sheets.  
● High attention to detail and ability to manage multiple campaigns simultaneously.  
● Experience working with SMB and Large Advertisers  
● Knowledge of SQL, dashboards, or BI tools is a plus  

Skills & Competencies

● Analytical and data-driven mindset  
● Strong execution & problem-solving skills  
● Clear communication and stakeholder management  
● Ability to work in fast-paced, high-volume environments  
● Ownership mindset with customer-first thinking 

 Why join us:

Work with a high-performing and passionate product, design, and engineering team. Shape the future of credit for millions of users. Build at scale in one of India’s most dynamic and regulated spaces. Flexible and inclusive work environment with fast decision-making and ownership.   

Compensation:  

If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you with enviable 500 mn+ registered users, 25mn+  merchants and depth of data in our ecosystem, we are in a unique position to democratize credit for deserving  consumers & merchants – and we are committed to it. India’s largest digital lending story is brewing here. It’s your  opportunity to be a part of the story!

● Monitor live campaigns for delivery, pacing, CTR, CVR, ROAS, and CPA. 
● Perform ongoing optimizations on bids, targeting, creatives, and budgets to maximize performance. 
● Identify and resolve delivery issues (under-delivery, drop in CTR, tracking gaps). 

Reporting & Insights 
● Prepare daily, weekly, and post-campaign reports for advertisers and internal stakeholders. 
● Analyze performance trends and convert data into actionable insights and recommendations. 
● Support QBRs and performance reviews with clear narratives and data storytelling.

Client & Internal Collaboration 
● Act as the operations SPOC for sales, account management, and product teams. 
● Work closely with Sales to understand client objectives and translate them into executable media plans. 
● Coordinate with creative, tech, and product teams to resolve issues and improve campaign outcomes. 

Platform & Process Excellence
● Maintain high operational accuracy with zero-defect campaign launches. Follow standard operating procedures while contributing to process improvements and automation. 
● Provide feedback on advertiser needs to help evolve Paytm Ads products and tools.

● Knowledge of SQL, dashboards, or BI tools is a plus

● Ability to work in fast-paced, high-volume environments

About Us :

Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce.
Paytm's mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.

About the Role :

We are looking for an experienced Category Lead to define, build, and scale one of our categories from the ground up
This is a high-impact, entrepreneurial role that combines category ownership, product thinking, business strategy, and cross-functional execution. The ideal candidate will have experience owning large business categories, driving growth, and building customer-centric products at scale.

What You'll Do :

- Own the end-to-end strategy, growth, and P&L of the category.
- Design customer-first financing journeys where interest is charged only on the utilized amount, creating a flexible borrowing experience.
- Identify new customer segments, use cases, and growth opportunities across merchants, D2C brands, SMEs, and digital businesses.
- Drive category performance through data-led decision making, experimentation, and continuous optimization.
- Monitor portfolio performance, customer adoption, profitability, and key business metrics.
- Work closely with leadership to launch and scale new initiatives as part of Paytm's new venture.

What We're Looking For :

- 7-10 years of experience in Category Management, Product Ownership, Business Management, or General Management.
- Strong experience owning and scaling a business category or product with measurable business impact.
- Strong understanding of customer journeys, marketplace ecosystems, supply chain, logistics, merchant platforms, or financial products.
- Demonstrated ability to manage large portfolios, drive business growth, and influence cross-functional teams.
- Excellent analytical, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.
- Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, zero-to-one environment.

Preferred Experience :

- Exposure to D2C ecosystems, managing large scale categories.
- Experience launching new categories or scaling products from inception to growth.
