About Us: 
Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytm's mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.

Role Summary:
We are seeking an experienced Quality & Training Lead to drive service excellence across our contact center operations. The ideal candidate will manage call quality programs, design and deliver training initiatives, coach teams, and ensure continuous improvement and operational performance.

The candidate must have strong proficiency in Kannada and Telugu and a solid understanding of contact center operations. Knowledge of additional South Indian languages (Tamil, Malayalam) or other regional languages will be an advantage.

Key Responsibilities:

1) Quality Management
- Develop, implement, and manage call quality monitoring frameworks and evaluation scorecards.
- Conduct regular call audits across voice channel.
- Analyze quality trends, identify improvement opportunities, and recommend corrective actions.
- Deliver actionable feedback to Track quality KPIs and ensure adherence to defined service standards and compliance requirements.
- Prepare and present quality reports, dashboards, and insights to management.

2) Training & Development:
- Conduct training needs analysis and identify skill gaps.
- Design and deliver new-hire, refresher, process, product, and behavioral training programs.
- Create and maintain training materials, SOPs, knowledge bases, and learning content.
- Evaluate training effectiveness through assessments, certifications, and performance tracking.
- Partner with operations teams to drive continuous learning and performance improvement.
- Conduct coaching sessions and calibration exercises with agents and team leaders.

3) Stakeholder Management:
- Collaborate closely with Operations, HR, and Business Leaders to improve process quality.
- Lead quality and training reviews with stakeholders.
- Support process transitions and new launches.
- Ensure alignment between training outcomes and business objectives.

Required Qualifications:

- Bachelor's degree in any discipline.
- 5–10 years of experience in contact center operations, with significant exposure to both Quality Assurance and Training functions.
- Experience managing quality and training programs for multilingual teams.
- Strong knowledge of quality frameworks, coaching methodologies, and adult learning principles.
- Proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint, and reporting tools.

Language Requirements (Mandatory):

- Fluent in Kannada and Telugu .
- Ability to conduct training sessions and quality calibrations in these languages.
- Knowledge of Tamil and/or Malayalam will be an added advantage.
- Knowledge of Hindi and English preferred.

Key Skills:

- Contact Center Quality Management
- Training Design & Delivery
- Call Monitoring & Audits
- Coaching & Feedback
- Performance Improvement
- Customer Experience Management
- Root Cause Analysis
- Data Analysis & Reporting
- Stakeholder Management
- Process Excellence
- Preferred Candidate Profile
- Strong communication and presentation skills.
- Experience supporting customer service teams across South Indian markets.
- Ability to influence stakeholders and drive behavioral change.
- Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-volume contact center environment.
- Willingness to travel occasionally between Bengaluru and Noida, if required.

We are seeking an experienced Quality & Training Lead to drive service excellence across our contact center operations. The ideal candidate will manage call quality programs, design and deliver training initiatives, coach teams, and ensure continuous improvement and operational performance.

The candidate must have strong proficiency in Kannada and Telugu and a solid understanding of contact center operations. Knowledge of additional South Indian languages (Tamil, Malayalam) or other regional languages will be an advantage.

Key Responsibilities:

1) Quality Management
- Develop, implement, and manage call quality monitoring frameworks and evaluation scorecards.
- Conduct regular call audits across voice channel.
- Analyze quality trends, identify improvement opportunities, and recommend corrective actions.
- Deliver actionable feedback to Track quality KPIs and ensure adherence to defined service standards and compliance requirements.
- Prepare and present quality reports, dashboards, and insights to management.

2) Training & Development:
- Conduct training needs analysis and identify skill gaps.
- Design and deliver new-hire, refresher, process, product, and behavioral training programs.
- Create and maintain training materials, SOPs, knowledge bases, and learning content.
- Evaluate training effectiveness through assessments, certifications, and performance tracking.
- Partner with operations teams to drive continuous learning and performance improvement.
- Conduct coaching sessions and calibration exercises with agents and team leaders.

3) Stakeholder Management:
- Collaborate closely with Operations, HR, and Business Leaders to improve process quality.
- Lead quality and training reviews with stakeholders.
- Support process transitions and new launches.
- Ensure alignment between training outcomes and business objectives.

- Bachelor's degree in any discipline.
- 5–10 years of experience in contact center operations, with significant exposure to both Quality Assurance and Training functions.
- Experience managing quality and training programs for multilingual teams.
- Strong knowledge of quality frameworks, coaching methodologies, and adult learning principles.
- Proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint, and reporting tools.

Language Requirements (Mandatory):

- Fluent in Kannada and Telugu .
- Ability to conduct training sessions and quality calibrations in these languages.
- Knowledge of Tamil and/or Malayalam will be an added advantage.
- Knowledge of Hindi and English preferred.

- Contact Center Quality Management
- Training Design & Delivery
- Call Monitoring & Audits
- Coaching & Feedback
- Performance Improvement
- Customer Experience Management
- Root Cause Analysis
- Data Analysis & Reporting
- Stakeholder Management
- Process Excellence

- Strong communication and presentation skills.
- Experience supporting customer service teams across South Indian markets.
- Ability to influence stakeholders and drive behavioral change.
- Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-volume contact center environment.

About Us
Paytm is India’s leading digital payments and financial services company, focused on driving consumers and merchants to its platform through a wide range of payment and financial solutions. Paytm enables consumers with services such as utility payments, money transfers, and digital commerce, while offering payment instruments including Paytm Wallet, UPI, Paytm Payments Bank Netbanking, FASTag, and Paytm Postpaid (Buy Now, Pay Later).
For merchants, Paytm provides acquiring and payment solutions such as Soundbox, EDC, QR, and Payment Gateway services, enabling seamless payment acceptance across online and offline channels.

About the Team
The team is part of Paytm’s Merchant Lending vertical and is responsible for driving merchant loan and merchant cash advance businesses across India. The team plays a key role in enabling merchant growth through financial inclusion and credit accessibility.

Role Overview
We are looking for a dynamic and execution-oriented Process Trainer to support the Merchant Lending business. The role involves designing and delivering engaging learning experiences, building scalable capability programs, and driving learning effectiveness across the Lending Merchant ecosystem.
The ideal candidate will work closely with business stakeholders and Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to simplify complex domain knowledge into impactful learning content and training interventions. The role will also focus on digitization of learning content and strengthening capability-building initiatives across teams.

Key Responsibilities
Learning Partnership & Capability Building
Act as the Learning Partner for the Merchant Lending business, demonstrating strong domain understanding.
Build and strengthen the Lending Merchant Training function focused on capability development, SOP effectiveness, and learning engagement.
Identify business capability gaps and design behavioral and functional training interventions.
Content Development & Training Delivery
Develop engaging learning content for classroom, virtual, and e-learning formats.
Work closely with SMEs to convert technical and operational concepts into easy-to-understand training modules.
Facilitate training sessions and learning workshops as required.
Learning Operations & Effectiveness
Manage learning calendars, training execution, dashboards, and impact measurement.
Drive digitization and scalability of learning content through LMS and digital learning platforms.
Track training effectiveness using data, feedback, and performance metrics.
Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Collaboration
Collaborate with business, operations, and cross-functional teams to drive L&D effectiveness.
Partner with stakeholders to align learning initiatives with business objectives and performance goals.
Ensure timely execution of learning interventions in a fast-paced business environment.

Ideal Candidate Profile
Proficiency in Marathi as a language
Minimum 3 years of experience in Learning & Development; BFSI domain experience preferred.
Experience in training delivery, facilitation, content development, and LMS management.
Strong understanding of learning frameworks, adult learning methodologies, and capability-building programs.
Excellent stakeholder management and collaboration skills.
Strong analytical mindset with the ability to measure training impact and effectiveness.
Comfortable working in dynamic, fast-paced, and high-growth environments.
High ownership, execution orientation, and willingness to continuously improve and experiment.

Skills & Qualifications
Strong communication, facilitation, and influencing skills.
Ability to design impactful learning experiences across multiple formats.
Proficiency in MS Office, Google Sheets, and digital learning tools.
Understanding of technology, user experience, and digital learning ecosystems.
Ability to work cross-functionally and drive alignment across teams.
Strong analytical and reporting capabilities.
Education: Graduation (mandatory)

Why Join Us
Opportunity to contribute to India’s largest digital lending and merchant ecosystem.
Be part of a collaborative, technology-driven environment focused on innovation and scale.
Drive impactful capability-building initiatives that directly influence business growth.
Gain exposure across business, operations, and learning functions in a high-growth organization.
Work in a culture that values ownership, collaboration, and continuous learning.

About Us:

Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytms mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.


About the Role:

Paytm is looking for an experienced, dynamic and experienced Trainer to design and deliver impactful training programs for sales teams across lending products and processes.


Expectations/ Requirements:

6+ years of experience in Sales Training, Learning & Development, or Training Delivery within Banking, NBFC, Fintech, or Lending domains.
The ideal candidate will be responsible for enhancing product knowledge, sales capabilities, and process adherence through engaging learning interventions and continuous coaching initiatives.
Design and deliver training programs for sales teams on lending products, sales processes, compliance requirements, and operational procedures.
Develop and maintain training content, including presentations, training manuals, SOPs, assessments, and e-learning modules.
Conduct classroom, virtual, and field-based training sessions to ensure effective knowledge transfer and skill development.
Collaborate with business stakeholders and subject matter experts to create practical and engaging learning experiences aligned with business objectives.
Evaluate trainee performance through assessments, feedback, and performance tracking to identify learning gaps and improvement areas.
Provide ongoing coaching and mentoring to sales teams to improve productivity, customer handling, and conversion effectiveness.
Monitor training effectiveness and recommend enhancements to training methodologies, content, and delivery mechanisms.
Ensure all training programs remain aligned with organizational goals, regulatory guidelines, and evolving business requirements.

Must Have: 

Should have good networking capabilities and be willing to travel extensively throughout their specified area. Skilled in coaching and mentoring, a quick learner who grasps and puts into application the new learnt ideas and concepts.

Superpowers/ Skills that will help you succeed in this role :

Strong understanding of lending products, sales processes, and customer acquisition practices.

Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.

Ability to create engaging training content and facilitate interactive learning sessions.
Proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint, Excel, and Learning Management Systems (LMS) is preferred.

Educational Qualification:

Graduate/Postgraduate in any discipline.
Certification in Training & Development or Learning Facilitation will be an added advantage.


Why join us?

A collaborative output driven program that brings cohesiveness across businesses through technology Improve the average revenue per use by increasing the cross-sell opportunities A solid 360 feedback from your peer teams on your support of their goals. Respect, that is earned, not demanded from your peers and manager
Compensation: If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you with enviable 500 mn+ registered users, 21 mn+ merchants and depth of data in our ecosystem, we are in a unique position to democratize credit for deserving consumers & merchants and we are committed to it. India’s largest digital lending story is brewing here. It’s your opportunity to be a part of the story!

 Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytms mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology. 

Role Overview

 We are looking for a high-agency Product Analyst to join the Lending product team at Paytm. This role sits at the intersection of analytics, product management, technology, and product operations. You will drive data-backed decision-making across lending funnels across acquisition and servicing, identify opportunities for impact, and take operational ownership of selected product workstreams to improve execution velocity and free up PM bandwidth. This is a high-impact role with direct influence on revenue and customer experience.

Key Responsibilities

Product Analytics & Insights

Own end-to-end funnel analytics for lending products (financial securities).
Build dashboards tracking key product metrics.
Conduct cohort analysis across user segments and their performance.
Design and evaluate A/B tests (pricing, UI flows, underwriting rules).
Create decision frameworks for feature prioritization backed by data.

Product Operations

Own release monitoring and post-release performance tracking.
Manage experiment rollouts and ensure clean measurement.

Key Metrics

Funnel conversion rates
Servicing and experience
Disbursal growth
Time-to-disbursal
Pricing & experimentation.

Expectations

• 3 to 6 years of experience in Product Analytics, preferably with a background in Lending.
• Strong SQL proficiency (mandatory).
• Experience with Python/R for modeling preferred.
•Strong understanding of credit lifecycle and lending unit economics.
• Experience building dashboards.
• High ownership mindset and bias for execution.
• Prior experience in a fast-paced B2C fintech environment (preferred).

Why join us

• A collaborative output driven program that brings cohesiveness across businesses through technology.
• Improve the average revenue per use by increasing the cross-sell opportunities.
•A solid 360 feedback from your peer teams on your support of their goals.

Key Responsibilities
1. You are a dynamic problem solver, driven by a passion for data and the compelling narratives it reveals. 
2. Constantly challenging the status quo, you possess a keen ability to understand and navigate its complexities.
3. Graduates/Post Grads from Tier 1/2 colleges with Engineering, Management/ Finance background are preferred.
4. Strong working knowledge in SQL, Excel and visualization tools like Looker, Tableau.
5. Understanding of Data-analysis languages like R/Python in core Statistical Concepts is expected.
6. Support the development, execution and optimization of growth campaigns across various channels to enhance user acquisition, engagement and retention.
7. Familiar with CRM platforms like Clevertap/Mo-engage. Familiarity with Digital marketing channels and metrics.
8. Develop and implement sophisticated customer segmentation strategies to personalize marketing efforts, enhance targeting accuracy, and drive impactful engagement.

About the Team

Paytm Ads is the digital advertising platform of Paytm, enabling brands to reach and engage with over 350M+ users across Paytm’s ecosystem of 200+ payment, commerce, and retail services—both online and offline. By leveraging transaction signals and behavioral insights, Paytm Ads enables advertisers to target highly relevant consumer cohorts and deliver performance-driven campaigns. 

About the Role

We are looking for a Manager – Product Analytics to drive data-led decision making across the Paytm Ads platform. This role works closely with Product, Data Engineering, Sales, and Operations teams to analyze product performance, user behavior, and campaign outcomes, translating data into actionable insights that improve advertiser and platform performance. 

Key Responsibilities:

● Build and maintain automated dashboards and BI reports for key product and revenue metrics. 
● Write advanced SQL queries to analyze large datasets and generate actionable insights. 
● Analyze product usage, funnels, retention, and feature adoption to identify growth opportunities. 
● Conduct A/B testing, cohort analysis, and segmentation to measure product and campaign impact. 
● Track and optimize digital marketing performance metrics such as CAC, ROI, CTR, and conversions. 
● Translate business/product questions into structured analysis recommendations for stakeholders. 

Qualifications: 

● B.E./B.Tech from a reputed engineering institute 
● Experience in Product Analytics, Management Consulting, Business Strategy, or Sales/Marketing Analytics roles. 
● Strong SQL expertise for large-scale data analysis and reporting. 
● Experience with BI tools such as Superset, Tableau, Power BI, or Looker. 
● Solid understanding of product analytics, marketing metrics, funnels, and experimentation frameworks. 
● Familiarity with digital marketing platforms such as Google Ads and Meta Ads Manager.

About Us:

Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytm’s mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.

About the team: 
Paytm Travel has revolutionized the travel industry - intending to empower millions of travelers who choose us as their preferred travel partner. Being one of the largest travel platforms in the country, we aim to not only ensure seamless, instant booking, but also a delightful journey. We strive to enrich the customer experience by making every transaction transparent, honest and hassle-free. To stay ahead of the curve, we are working aggressively towards our ambition to make travel affordable for all. With this customer centricity at our core, we strive to make Paytm Travel synonymous with trustworthy travel partners.


Job Summary
We are looking for a visionary and results-driven Director of Product to lead Paytm’s Travel business. This role will own the end-to-end product strategy and execution across travel categories, shaping how millions of users discover, book, and manage their journeys. The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in the travel ecosystem, strong business acumen, and a proven ability to lead cross-functional teams to deliver scalable, high-impact products. You will drive growth, optimize customer experience, and build innovative solutions in partnership with engineering, design, and business teams.

Responsibilities
1. Define and drive the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Paytm Travel, aligning with overall business goals and growth targets.
2. Identify new opportunities across the travel ecosystem (flights, trains, buses, hotels) through market insights, customer needs, and competitive analysis.
3. Lead and mentor a team of product managers, fostering a high-performance and outcome-driven culture.
4. Partner closely with engineering, design, business, and external partners to deliver scalable, high-quality travel experiences.
5. Own key business metrics including conversion, retention, revenue, and customer satisfaction across the travel funnel.
6. Oversee end-to-end product lifecycle from ideation to launch and continuous optimization at scale.
7. Drive data-informed decision-making by leveraging analytics, experimentation, and customer insights.
8. Collaborate with marketing, supply d operations teams to execute go-to-market strategies and unlock growth opportunities.
9. Build strong relationships with partners and stakeholders to enhance supply, pricing, and overall user experience.

Qualifications
1. 5+ years of experience in the travel industry (flights, trains, buses, hotels) with strong product leadership.
2. Deep understanding of travel booking flows, supply ecosystem, pricing, and post-booking experience.
3. Proven track record of building and scaling high-impact consumer travel products.
4. Strong analytical mindset with experience driving growth, conversion, and customer experience.
5. Excellent leadership and stakeholder management skills in fast-paced, cross-functional environments.


Why join us?
·         A collaborative output driven program that brings cohesiveness across businesses through technology
·         Improve the average revenue per use by increasing the cross-sell opportunities
·         A solid 360 feedback from your peer teams on your support of their goals
·         Respect, that is earned, not demanded from your peers and manager
 
Compensation: If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you. With enviable 500 mn+ registered users, 21 mn+ merchants and depth of data in our ecosystem, we are in a unique position to democratize credit for deserving consumers & merchants – and we are committed to it. India’s largest digital lending story is brewing here. It’s your opportunity to be a part of the story!

Be a part of one of Paytm's fastest growing businesses - Travel. Travel was launched in 2016 and in less than 12 months we became India's 2nd largest online travel booking platform for Flights, Trains, Hotels and Bus tickets. Paytm's Travel business is entirely based out of Bangalore. We are like a 300-member startup within Paytm working in a fast paced environment. Our team comprises Product & Design, Engineering, Business and Customer Experience functions. Join us if you would like to work in a fast paced, agile, entrepreneurial environment where every day brings with it an opportunity for you to create a dent in the universe. 

Our Story
Paytm Travel has revolutionized the travel industry - with a goal to empower millions of travelers who choose us as their preferred travel partner. We are no. 2 in the travel segment, in India, within a span of few years, which proves our capability and potential to become no. 1 in the near future. Being one of the largest travel platforms in the country, our aim is to not only ensure seamless, instant booking, but also a delightful journey. We strive to enrich customer experience by making every transaction transparent, honest and hassle free. To stay ahead of the curve, we are working aggressively towards our ambition to make travel affordable for all. With this customer centricity at our core, we strive to make Paytm Travel synonymous with a trustworthy travel partner.  

What You'll Do:
Own the roadmap for a key consumer-facing product within the travel ecosystem
Collaborate cross-functionally with design, engineering, and business teams to deliver features that resonate with users
Engage in technical discussions, understanding system design and architecture to make informed decisions
Leverage AI technologies like LLMs (e.g. GPT, Claude), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), recommendation systems, and conversational agents to enhance product intelligence and personalization
Balance speed and quality, prioritizing rapid iterations over perfection to meet market demands

What We're Looking For:
5+ years of product management experience in consumer internet companies
Mobile product experience (Android, iOS) is a must, with a keen eye for user experience. Should be able to have brainstorming discussions with tech on flutter vs native app.
Hands-on experience with AI agents or agentic AI frameworks (e.g. AutoGPT, LangChain, OpenAgents) is a significant plus
Educational foundation in Computer Science or a related technical field (preferred), MBA from a top tier b-school is a plus.
Excellent data analysis and insights skills – comfort with metrics, funnels, experiments, and decision-making driven by data
Analytical mindset, with the ability to question business constructs and drive data-informed decisions
Excellent communication skills, capable of articulating ideas and collaborating with diverse teams

Why join us :A collaborative output driven program that brings cohesiveness across businesses through technology Improve the average revenue per use by increasing the cross-sell opportunities A solid 360 feedback from your peer teams on your support of their goals. Respect, that is earned, not demanded from your peers and manager

About Paytm   
Paytm is a pioneer of digital payments in India, serving over 450 million consumers and 45 million merchants across  payments, financial services, and commerce. Over the years, Paytm has built deep in-house capabilities across  technology, data, and operations to operate at scale with high reliability.   

About the role 
We're looking for product managers who think deeply about consumers and move fast. You'll own a meaningful  area of product used by a large and diverse set of Indian consumers, making decisions that show up in people's  hands within weeks. This is a role for builders who treat ambiguity as opportunity.  

What you'll do  
You'll own the strategy and execution for your product area end to end — from identifying the right problem to  shipping and iterating. You'll spend real time understanding users (not just reading research decks), translate  insight into crisp product bets, and partner closely with design, engineering, and business to ship. You'll be  measured on outcomes, not output, and you'll be expected to drive your area with minimal hand-holding.  

What we're looking for 
● 3–8 years of experience, ideally in entrepreneurship, building consumer products or top-tier consulting.  
● Strong consumer intuition — you have opinions about why products work, and you can defend them with  both logic and evidence.  
● High agency. You define the problem, find the path, and get it done without waiting for permission.  
● Sharp analytical and structured thinking, balanced with a bias for action.  
● Comfort operating in a fast-paced, high-ownership environment where speed and judgment both matter.

About Paytm   
Paytm is a pioneer of digital payments in India, serving over 450 million consumers and 45 million merchants across  payments, financial services, and commerce. Over the years, Paytm has built deep in-house capabilities across  technology, data, and operations to operate at scale with high reliability.   

About the role 
We're looking for product managers who think deeply about consumers and move fast. You'll own a meaningful  area of product used by a large and diverse set of Indian consumers, making decisions that show up in people's  hands within weeks. This is a role for builders who treat ambiguity as opportunity.  

What you'll do  
You'll own the strategy and execution for your product area end to end — from identifying the right problem to  shipping and iterating. You'll spend real time understanding users (not just reading research decks), translate  insight into crisp product bets, and partner closely with design, engineering, and business to ship. You'll be  measured on outcomes, not output, and you'll be expected to drive your area with minimal hand-holding.  

What we're looking for 
● 3–8 years of experience, ideally in entrepreneurship, building consumer products or top-tier consulting.  
● Strong consumer intuition — you have opinions about why products work, and you can defend them with  both logic and evidence.  
● High agency. You define the problem, find the path, and get it done without waiting for permission.  
● Sharp analytical and structured thinking, balanced with a bias for action.  
● Comfort operating in a fast-paced, high-ownership environment where speed and judgment both matter.  

Why this matters  
You’ll be at the cutting edge of tech and finance. You'll build for one of the largest and most diverse consumer  bases in the world, ship at scale and at pace. The problems are hard, the impact is immediate, and the autonomy is  real.  

Why join us? 
● A collaborative output driven program that brings cohesiveness across businesses through technology  
● Improve the average revenue per use by increasing the cross-sell opportunities   
● A solid 360 feedback from your peer teams on your support of their goals   
● Respect, that is earned, not demanded from your peers and manager

About Us:Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytm’s mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.

About team : 
Paytm Money is the wealth-tech and stockbroking . It offers services like mutual fund investments, stock trading, ETFs, IPOs, F&O, and retirement products through a user-friendly mobile app and web platform. The company focuses on making investing simple, affordable, and accessible for retail investors across India.

About the Role
We are seeking a passionate and detail-oriented Product Manager – Broking to join our team at Paytm Money. The ideal candidate should have a solid understanding of the broking ecosystem, trading platforms, and capital markets, with hands-on experience in building scalable, user-focused digital products. This is an individual contributor (IC) role that involves ownership of the entire product lifecycle — from strategy to execution — to deliver best-in-class investment & trading experiences.

Key Responsibilities
● Own the end-to-end product lifecycle for broking and trading products across Equity, Derivatives, Commodities, ETFs, and related offerings.
● Define the product vision, roadmap, and strategy aligned with business and regulatory goals.
● Collaborate with technology, design, operations, compliance, and business teams to conceptualize and deliver impactful product features.
● Conduct market research, competitor benchmarking, and user behavior analysis to identify growth and innovation opportunities.
● Translate customer and business needs into clear PRDs, wireframes, and user stories.
● Ensure all features adhere to regulatory, risk, and compliance frameworks (SEBI, Exchanges, etc.).
● Track product adoption, engagement, and retention through data-driven metrics and analytics tools; optimize continuously for better user experience.
● Stay updated on market trends, SEBI guidelines, and technology advancements in the broking and wealth-tech domain.

Requirements
● 7+ years of experience, with minimum 3 years in Broking, Capital Markets, or
WealthTech domain.
● In-depth understanding of trading platforms, OMS/RMS, KYC, settlements, and
compliance processes.
● Proven track record in managing digital products in broking, fintech, or investment
platforms.
● Strong analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.
● Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration abilities.
● Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth fintech environment.

Superpowers that will help you to succeed
● Exposure to app-based or digital trading platforms.
● Understanding of mutual funds, advisory, and wealth management products.
● Experience in scaling B2C fintech products and driving customer engagement.

Why join us :  We aim at bringing half a billion Indians into the mainstream economy, and everyone working here is striving to achieve that goal. Our success is rooted in our people’s collective energy and unwavering focus on the customers, and that’s how it will always be. We are the largest merchant acquirer in India.

Compensation: If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth foryou.With enviable 500 mn+ registered users, 21 mn+ merchants, and depth of data in our ecosystem, we are in a unique position to democratize credit for deserving consumers & merchants – and we are committed to it. India’s largest digital lending story is brewing here. It’s your opportunity to be a part of the story!

First-Party Data & Audience Systems Leverage Paytm’s rich transactional and behavioral data to build high-quality audience segments Design and scale privacy-safe data activation frameworks, including clean room (DCR) capabilities Enable advertisers to activate their own data in a secure, compliant manner.

3. ML-Led Decisioning & Optimization Lead the development of machine learning–driven systems for: Bidding & budget allocation Ad ranking & personalization Audience selection and lookalike modeling Drive continuous improvement in model performance and business outcomes.

4. Data Infrastructure & Platform Thinking Build and evolve data platforms and decisioning engines that power real-time ad delivery and optimization Ensure systems are scalable, reliable, and capable of handling high-volume, low-latency decisioning.

5. 0 → 1 and Scale Journeys Lead end-to-end product lifecycle from ideation to launch and scale Identify new monetization opportunities across: On-platform inventory Off-platform activation (DSP integrations, partnerships)Drive adoption and usage through strong collaboration with GTM teams.

6. Cross-Functional Leadership Partner closely with: Engineering (platform build)Data Science (ML models)Sales & Partnerships (market adoption)Align product strategy with broader business goals

What We’re Looking For

* Experience 10–15 years of product management.

 * Experience 6+ years in Ads / Performance Marketing / Growth platforms.

* Experience in D2C, E-commerce, Marketplaces, or AdTech ecosystems.

*Strong customer empathy with a focus on delivering measurable impact.

•Improve the average revenue per use by increasing the cross-sell opportunities·

•Respect, that is earned, not demanded from your peers and manager.

Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytm’s mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology. 

About the Role

Paytm Ads is building the next generation of advertising infrastructure by combining high-intent first-party commerce data, AI-driven decisioning, and a scalable programmatic ecosystem.

As a PMII / SPM, you will own key components of Paytm's monetization infrastructure, enabling seamless integration with DSPs, SSPs, exchanges, SDK partners and measurement providers. You will build scalable platform capabilities that maximize advertiser demand, improve publisher yield, and expand Paytm's programmatic ecosystem.

This role is ideal for someone passionate about solving complex AdTech problems and building products at scale in a fast-moving environment.

What You'll Drive

Programmatic Ad Stack

* Own the roadmap for Paytm's programmatic monetization platform. 
* Build and enhance capabilities across OpenRTB, auction infrastructure, demand routing and inventory monetization.
* Improve platform scalability, latency and auction efficiency. 

Partner Integrations

* Drive integrations with leading SSPs, DSPs, exchanges and demand partners. 
* Build scalable APIs and onboarding frameworks for external monetization partners. 
* Work closely with business teams to accelerate partner launches. 

SDK & Monetization Infrastructure

* Own SDK integrations across internal and third-party monetization platforms. 
* Enable access to premium demand through SDK and server-side integrations. 
* Improve monetization performance across app inventory while maintaining user experience.

 Measurement & Attribution

* Build integrations with MMPs, DCR providers, fraud detection and measurement partners. 
* Improve attribution accuracy and campaign measurement capabilities. 
* Enable privacy-first measurement solutions. 

Platform Execution

* Own the end-to-end product lifecycle—from discovery and design through launch, experimentation and scale. Partner closely with Engineering, Architecture, Data Science, Sales, Partnerships and Operations teams. 
* Define success metrics and continuously optimize platform performance.

What We're Looking For

* Experience3-7 years of Product Management experience.
* 2+ years in AdTech, Programmatic Advertising or Marketing Technology.
* Experience building B2B platforms, advertising products or marketplace products.
* Demonstrated ownership of products from concept through launch and scale.

Preferred Expertise

* Programmatic Advertising (SSP, DSP, Ad Exchange, Open RTB)
* Publisher monetization and yield optimization Campaign Management
* Platforms Audience targeting and identity solutionsAuction systems and pricing models.
* Attribution and measurement AI/ML-powered advertising products Retail Media or Commerce Media.

Why join us

•A collaborative output driven program that brings cohesiveness across businesses through technology·
•Improve the average revenue per use by increasing the cross-sell opportunities·
•A solid 360 feedback from your peer teams on your support of their goals·
•Respect, that is earned, not demanded from your peers and manager.

Compensation:

If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you With enviable 500 mn+ registered users, 17 mn+ merchants and depth of data in our ecosystem, we are in a unique position to democratize credit for deserving consumers & merchants – and we are committed to it. India’s largest digital lending story is brewing here. It’s your opportunity to be a part of the story!

Paytm's Unified Payments Interface (UPI) offering that enables users to make instant bank-to-bank payments directly from their linked bank accounts.

We are looking for an AI Product Manager to lead the development of Agentic AI solutions for Paytm's UPI ecosystem. The role focuses on building intelligent, autonomous AI agents that enhance payment experiences, automate customer support, detect fraud, provide personalized financial insights, and optimize payment success rates.

Key Responsibilities

-Build autonomous AI agents for payments, dispute resolution, customer assistance, and transaction recommendations.
-Collaborate with Engineering, Data Science, Design, and Risk teams to deliver AI-first products.
-Leverage LLMs, AI agents, and workflow automation to improve user engagement and operational efficiency.
-Drive experimentation using analytics, customer insights, and A/B testing.
-Ensure compliance with NPCI guidelines, privacy, and responsible AI practices.

Superpowers/ Skills that will help you succeed in this role: ·        
-3–8 years of Product Management experience in FinTech, Payments, or AI products.
-Understanding of UPI, digital payments, and banking ecosystems.
-Experience with Generative AI, LLMs, Agentic AI frameworks, and AI product development.
-Strong analytical skills with SQL and product analytics tools.
-Excellent stakeholder management and execution capabilities.

We’re rebuilding how analytics gets done at the company. As a central product team, we drive the build and adoption of our data platform in close partnership with consumer teams across business verticals (Online Payments and Offline Payments) and functions (Growth, Risk, Data Science).

About the Role:

This is a senior Data Product Management role for someone who enjoys marrying business analytics problems to simplified data design solutions. You will own a portfolio within the Central Data and AI Product charter, lead a small, high-leverage team (1–2 PMs and 1 analyst), and partner with engineering and business stakeholders to ship products that scale across the organisation.

Key Responsibilities:

* Lead and grow a team of product managers and analysts (1–2 PMs and 1 analyst) — hiring, coaching, performance management, and career development.
* Drive the end-to-end data product development lifecycle — from discovery and scoping through delivery, adoption, and iteration. 
* Define  and articulate the product vision, strategy, and roadmap in alignment with company goals and market trends.
* Partner with cross-functional teams — business, growth, risk, and data science — to understand customer needs and align product offerings to work cleanly with agentic analytical workflows. 
* Work closely with engineering on technical design, development, sprint planning, and prioritisation across our stack (AWS, Spark, EMR, EC2, Hive, Trino, Superset) — making thoughtful product trade-offs informed by the underlying platform.
* Manage senior stakeholders and executive communication — surface trade-offs, drive alignment, and represent the data platform externally.
* Leverage agentic development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, and similar) day-to-day to accelerate value delivery.

Requirements:

* 5+ years of Product Management experience, with 3+ years managing mid-sized teams.
* Strong command of SQL, data modelling, and both streaming and batch processing.
* Working knowledge of our stack and how it shapes product decisions: AWS cloud services for the data warehouse, Spark, EMR, EC2, Hive, Trino, and Superset.
* Understanding of data governance and regulatory compliance (DPDPA).
* Deep expertise in data modelling — dimensional modelling, semantic layers, taxonomy. 
* Look ML or Look ML-style layer experience is a strong plus.
* Hands-on with agentic tools (Claude Code, Cursor) for day-to-day work.
* Strong communicator — the role lives at the seam between consumer teams and the platform team.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Prior experience managing complex payments data and stream/batch processing at scale.
• Exposure to conversational AI or agentic product analytics. 
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Why join us

•A collaborative output driven program that brings cohesiveness across businesses through technology·
•Improve the average revenue per use by increasing the cross-sell opportunities·
•A solid 360 feedback from your peer teams on your support of their goals·
•Respect, that is earned, not demanded from your peers and manager.

About the team:
Paytm Travel is the travel and ticketing platform of Paytm, offering seamless booking services for flights, trains, buses, hotels, and other travel-related needs. The platform leverages technology to simplify travel planning and booking for millions of users across India, providing a convenient, secure, and user-friendly experience through the Paytm ecosystem.

Responsibilities: 
1)Support the roadmap for a key consumer-facing product within the travel ecosystem, owning well-defined features and flows end to end. 
2) Collaborate cross-functionally with design, engineering, and business teams to deliver features that resonate with users. 
3) Participate in technical discussions, building an understanding of system design and architecture to make informed decisions. 
4)Leverage AI technologies like LLMs (e.g. GPT, Claude), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), recommendation systems, and conversational agents to enhance product intelligence and personalization. 
5)Balance speed and quality, prioritizing rapid iterations over perfection to meet market demands. 
6)Dive into product metrics and user funnels to identify opportunities and measure impact of shipped features.

Requirements:
1)2+ years of product management experience in consumer internet companies (preferred); strong candidates from analytics, engineering, or design backgrounds transitioning into product are encouraged to apply. 
2)Mobile product experience (Android, iOS) is a must, with a keen eye for user experience. 
3)Should be able to have brainstorming discussions with tech on flutter vs native app. 
4)Exposure to or curiosity about AI agents or agentic AI frameworks (e.g. AutoGPT, LangChain, OpenAgents) is a significant plus. 
5)Educational foundation in Computer Science or a related technical field (preferred); MBA from a top tier b-school is a plus.

About Paytm Group:   
Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile QR  payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce.  Paytm’s mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.   

About the Role  
We’re looking for a Product Manager to own cross-border payments end-to-end - strategy, roadmap, execution, and  iteration. This is a hands-on PM role: you write PRDs, run sprints, dig into data, and ship. You need to understand how  money moves internationally - FX, settlement, compliance rails and be comfortable using AI to push product capabilities  forward.  

What You’ll Do  
• Own product vision, roadmap, and OKRs for cross-border payments  
• Write PRDs, define acceptance criteria, run sprint planning, and own delivery from spec through launch and  post-launch monitoring  
• Partner with engineering on system design—payment orchestration, FX engine, ledger, reconciliation, API contracts  
• Drive customer research: interviews, usability tests, funnel analysis, side-by-side sessions with support teams  
• Collaborate with legal, compliance, and risk to ship products that meet regulatory requirements across jurisdictions  while keeping friction low  
• Identify where AI/ML creates real product leverage (routing, fraud, pricing, ops automation)  
• Competitive benchmarking across the cross-border landscape to inform roadmap and positioning  

Must Have  
• 6+ years in product management with a track record of shipping at scale  
• 3–4+ years in FinTech, Payments, or Financial Services; direct exposure to cross-border money movement, FX, or  remittances strongly preferred  
• Solid understanding of payment systems: payment processors, FX engines, settlement mechanics, SWIFT/local rails,  reconciliation 
• Hands-on with PRDs, sprints, and working directly with engineering in an agile setup  
• Working knowledge of regulatory frameworks (AML/KYC, sanctions screening, licensing) in cross-border context  
• Clear communicator who can write a spec, present to leadership, and align cross-functional teams  

Good to Have  
• Shipped or contributed to products leveraging AI/ML (intelligent routing, risk scoring, dynamic pricing, LLM-based  ops automation)  
• Corridor-level understanding-why US→India behaves differently from UK→Nigeria (liquidity, partner rails,  settlement windows)  • Design sensibility—can critique a wireframe and push back when UX doesn’t serve the user  
• Technical fluency—can read an API spec, discuss schema trade-offs, understand event-driven architectures  

Why join us?  
● A collaborative output driven program that brings cohesiveness across businesses through technology  
● Improve the average revenue per use by increasing the cross-sell opportunities 
● A solid 360 feedback from your peer teams on your support of their goals  
● Respect, that is earned, not demanded from your peers and manager  

Compensation: 
If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you With enviable 500 mn+ registered users, 17 mn+ merchants  and depth of data in our ecosystem, we are in a unique position to democratize credit for deserving consumers &  merchants - and we are committed to it.

About Paytm:
Paytm is India's leading financial services company offering full-stack payments and financial
solutions to consumers, merchants, and online platforms. Our mission is to bring half a billion
Indians into the mainstream economy through payments, commerce, banking, investments, and
financial services.

About the Role:
We are looking for an experienced Program Manager (DGM/GM) to drive strategic initiatives for
Paytm's Lending EMI business. The role will own end-to-end program execution across No Cost
EMI, EMI at Checkout, and other lending solutions, ensuring seamless collaboration between
Business, Product, Technology, Operations, Risk, Compliance, Finance, Marketing, and external
partners. The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of the Lending EMI
ecosystem, excellent stakeholder management skills, and experience in driving large
cross-functional programs, process excellence, and business growth.

About the Team:
The Lending EMI team is responsible for building and scaling innovative financing solutions by
collaborating with Banks, NBFCs, and internal teams to deliver seamless customer and merchant
experiences.

Key Responsibilities:
● Drive end-to-end execution of strategic Lending EMI programs, ensuring timely delivery
against business goals.
● Partner with cross-functional teams to manage program timelines, dependencies, risks,
and successful implementation.
● Lead internal stakeholder management and align Business, Product, Technology,
Operations, Risk, Compliance, Finance, and Marketing teams.
● Design and improve scalable processes to enhance operational efficiency and customer
experience.
● Manage partner onboarding, technology integrations, governance, and ongoing
engagement with Banks and NBFCs.
● Own subvention management, financial reconciliation, reporting, MIS, and program
governance.
● Ensure brand alignment across product launches, merchant communication, and partner
initiatives.
● Monitor program performance through data-driven insights and recommend process
and business improvements.
● Stay abreast of market trends, EMI offerings, and competitive landscape to support
strategic initiatives.

Preferred Qualifications
● Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Finance, or a related field. MBA preferred.
● 6-12 years of experience in Program Management, FinTech, Banking, NBFC, Payments,
or Consumer Finance.
● Hands-on experience with No Cost EMI, EMI at Checkout, Consumer Finance, or Digital
Lending.
● Strong understanding of EMI products, subvention models, market practices, and
partner ecosystems.
● Proven track record of managing cross-functional programs and delivering business
outcomes.

Required Skills
● Program Owner
● Strategic Thinking & Execution
● Internal Stakeholder Management
● Cross-functional Collaboration
● Process Design & Operational Excellence
● Lending EMI & Consumer Finance
● No Cost EMI & EMI at Checkout
● Subvention Management
● Business Reporting & Financial Reconciliation
● Product & Technology Coordination
● Analytical & Problem-Solving Skills
● Excellent Communication & Presentation Skills

● 3 - 5 years of experience in managing projects across cross functional teams 
● Experience working directly with business stakeholders. 
● Experience in strategy consulting, ceo office, chief of staff, EIR roles 
● Bachelor's degree in Engineering, business or related technical field 
● Strong oral and written communication skills are crucial 
● Prior work experience in insurance or fintech preferred 
● Structured thought process to help think clearly, analyze quantitatively, problem-solve and prioritize tasks 
● Ability to comfortably and confidently present to all levels within the enterprise and to work with both technical and non-technical individuals 
● Results oriented person with a strong delivery focus who can work independently and collaboratively with teams 


Why join us?

A collaborative output driven program that brings cohesiveness across businesses through technology
Improve the average revenue per use by increasing the cross-sell opportunities
A solid 360 feedback from your peer teams on your support of their goals
Respect, that is earned, not demanded from your peers and manager

Compensation:

If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you With enviable 500 mn+ registered users, 17 mn+ merchants and depth of data in our ecosystem, we are in a unique position to democratize credit for deserving consumers & merchants - and we are committed to it.

Position Overview
We are seeking a highly analytical and data-driven Payment Reconciliation Specialist / Analyst to oversee our end-to-end financial reconciliation processes. In this role, you will be responsible for managing high-volume transaction datasets, tracking payment lifecycles, and ensuring absolute financial accuracy across internal systems, payment gateways, and banking partners.
The ideal candidate bridges the gap between finance and technology—possessing strong core accounting fundamentals alongside advanced technical skills in SQL and Python to drive automation, eliminate manual workflows, and optimize payment processing costs.

Key Responsibilities

1. Core Payment & Financial Reconciliation
End-to-End Auditing: Validate transaction records across internal systems, payment gateways (PGs), banking partners, settlement files, and merchant reports.
High-Volume Data Analysis: Analyze massive transaction datasets to promptly identify mismatches, pending settlements, duplicate transactions, and financial exceptions.
Chargeback Management: Monitor disputed transactions, track the complete chargeback lifecycle, validate reversal entries, and ensure accurate accounting adjustments/recovery.
Finance & Accounting Support: Validate transaction postings, track pending receivables, manage refund accounting, handle merchant payout reconciliation, and assist with balance sheet reconciliation.

2. Cost Optimization & Reporting
PG Cost Analysis: Monitor and analyze Payment Gateway costs (MDR charges, transaction processing fees, bank charges, gateway settlement fees) to identify cost-optimization opportunities.
MIS & Dashboards: Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly MIS reports and design reconciliation dashboards for leadership, finance, and operations teams to support audit readiness.

3. Data Engineering & Process Automation
SQL Data Extraction: Write complex SQL queries for reconciliation checks, exception reporting, and data validation across large transactional databases.
Python Automation: Utilize Python for data processing, large-scale data analysis, report generation, and data cleansing to significantly reduce manual operational effort.
Continuous Improvement: Lead automation initiatives to improve reconciliation turnaround times, strengthen internal financial controls, and minimize operational risk.

4. Stakeholder & Compliance Management
Vendor Collaboration: Partner with banks, payment gateways, and internal cross-functional teams to resolve operational issues and improve overall payment efficiency.
Audit & Compliance: Ensure strict adherence to internal financial controls, accounting standards, audit requirements, and operational risk management policies.

Required Skills & Qualifications

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Commerce, Data Analytics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field.
Experience: 3–6 years of experience in payment reconciliation, fintech operations, payment gateway systems, or financial data analysis.
Technical Skills :Advanced SQL: Proven ability to query, join, and analyze complex relational databases.
Python: Proficiency in writing scripts for data cleansing, manipulation (e.g., Pandas, NumPy), and process automation.
Excel: Advanced knowledge of pivot tables, VLOOKUPs/XLOOKUPs, and complex formulas.
Domain Knowledge: Deep understanding of the payment ecosystem (MDR, settlement cycles, chargebacks, merchant payouts, and banking APIs).
Analytical Mindset: Exceptional problem-solving skills with an eagle-eye attention to detail.

About the Team: The Compliance department has five areas of responsibility—identification, monitoring, advisory, reporting and review for the entity with respect to regulations/ laws.

 About the role: This role includes managing regulatory compliance for UPI TPAP, BBPS and Digital Lending Business. The successful candidate will be responsible for individually contributing and ensuring compliance with relevant laws, regulations, and guidelines related primarily to UPI TPAP, BBPS and Digital Lending. The ideal candidate should have experience in relevant domain dealing with RBI and NPCI obligations preferably in a fintech environment, bank and possess strong self-driven skills to manage compliance effectively. 

Expectations/ Requirements: 
1) Regulatory Compliance Management and Monitoring: Monitoring and interpreting regulations and guidelines in the domain of UPI TPAP, BBPS and Digital Lending and ensuring compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and guidelines. Provide informed compliance advisory to the internal stakeholders on the applicability of regulatory laws and guidelines. 
2) Policy and Procedure Development: Develop, implement, and maintain compliance policies and procedures ensuring that they are up-to-date. 
3) Regulatory Reporting: Prepare and submit timely and accurate compliance reports to senior management and regulators, as required.
 4) Compliance Testing/Review and Risk Assessment: Conduct regular compliance review and risk assessments related to UPI TPAP, BBPS and digital lending products, identify potential compliance risks, and implement appropriate risk mitigation measures.
 5) Training and Awareness: Develop and deliver training programs to employees and relevant stakeholders to enhance compliance awareness. 
6) Relationship Management: Collaborate with cross-functional teams such as legal, risk, operations, and technology to ensure compliance and resolve any compliance-related issues.
 7) Stay Updated: Stay updated with changes in relevant laws, regulations, and guidelines and proactively implement necessary changes in compliance policies and procedures.

 Superpowers/ Skills that will help you succeed in this role:

 1)  Work Experience: 5+ Years of relevant experience in regulatory compliance, preferably in a fintech environment or bank. 
2)  Strong Knowledge: Sound understanding of RBI and NPCI regulations and applicable laws. Understanding of management of compliance function.
 3)  Analytical Skills: Ability to conduct risk assessments and compliance reviews, analyze complex information, and provide practical and effective compliance solutions.
4) Attention to Detail: Strong attention to detail and accuracy in compliance monitoring, reporting, and documentation. 
5)  Proactive and Collaborative Approach: Proactive approach to identifying and addressing potential compliance risks and issues in a timely manner. Interpersonal skills and ability to collaborate and work effectively with cross-functional teams, senior management, and regulators.
 6)  Adaptability: Ability to work independently and as part of a team, ability to adapt to changing regulatory requirements and business needs and implement necessary changes in compliance policies and procedures. 
7)  Ethical Conduct: High level of integrity, professionalism, and ethical conduct in dealing with sensitive and confidential information. 
8)  Proficient in using compliance management software and tools. 

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Law, Business Administration, or related field. A Master’s degree or professional certification (e.g., CA, CS, CFA, FRM) is preferred. 

Why join us?: 
Merit-based culture that thrives on self-motivated & driven individuals who set out to make a successful career in India’s fastest-growing Fintech Organization. Agile & democratic setup that gives space to your creativity, and offers the opportunity to work at scale coupled with an environment that encourages diverse perspectives at all times. 

Compensation: If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you. With enviable 500 mn+ registered users, 21 mn+ merchants and depth of data in our ecosystem, we are in a unique position to democratize credit for deserving consumers & merchants – and we are committed to it.

Job Description:
Role: Relationship Manager – MTF HNI Segment

Objective of the Role

Drive growth, acquire new customers, activation, and retention of HNI MTF clients by building strong relationships, improving engagement, and increasing capital deployment across the MTF book.

Key Responsibilities
1. HNI Client Engagement
Own a portfolio of HNI MTF clients
Drive regular engagement through calls, messages, and structured outreach
Educate clients on MTF usage, leverage opportunities, and platform features
2. Revenue & Book Expansion
Increase MTF utilization among assigned clients
Identify upsell opportunities across equity + MTF
Improve wallet share per client
3. Activation & Retention
Reactivate dormant HNI users
Reduce churn in high-value segments
Ensure consistent usage of MTF facility
4. Relationship Management
Act as single point of contact for assigned HNI users
Resolve queries in coordination with support/product teams
Build trust and long-term engagement
5. Market Intelligence
Gather user feedback and competitive insights
Share patterns from HNI cohort behavior with product/growth teams

Desired Profile
Experience in brokerage, wealth management, or trading platforms preferred
Strong communication and persuasion skills
Comfort with high-frequency client interaction
Execution-focused and target-driven mindset

KPIs for Success
Increase in MTF activation rate among HNI users
Acquire new HNI customers
Growth in average book size per HNI client
Improvement in retention / reduced churn in HNI cohort
Revenue contribution from managed cohort

Sales Excellence Lead, Inference and Agentic AI

Location: Noida

Company: Paytm

About Paytm: Paytm is a pioneer of digital payments in India, serving over 450 million consumers and 45 million merchants across payments, financial services, and commerce. Over the years, Paytm has built deep in-house capabilities across technology, data, and operations to operate at scale with high reliability. Paytm is building a full stack AI platform focussed on Inference and Agents, enabling large enterprises to deploy AI driven automation across sales, service, operations, and analytics. The Inference and Agentic AI team operates as a cross functional unit spanning engineering, product, data science, business management, and sales, and owns the full lifecycle of AI solutions from opportunity discovery to deployment and scale.

Role Overview: Paytm is looking to hire a Sales Excellence Lead within the Inference and Agentic AI organization to drive sales effectiveness, funnel governance, and sales enablement across Paytm's AI products. This role will work closely with sales leadership, business teams, product teams, and marketing teams to improve sales productivity, strengthen pipeline conversion, and accelerate revenue growth. The role will own sales review cadences, performance tracking, enablement programs, product readiness, and sales execution excellence across enterprise and mid market segments. The ideal candidate combines analytical rigor with strong stakeholder management and a passion for building scalable sales processes and enablement frameworks.

Key Responsibilities: Sales Performance and Funnel GovernanceOwn the operating rhythm for weekly, monthly, and quarterly sales reviews across enterprise and mid market sales teams. Track and analyze funnel performance across lead generation, opportunity creation, pipeline progression, proposal conversion, closures, activation, and expansion. Identify bottlenecks, conversion leakages, and productivity gaps across sales channels and recommend corrective actions. Drive structured opportunity reviews, pipeline reviews, and deal progression reviews with sales leadership. Build actionable dashboards and reports highlighting performance against targets, forecast accuracy, and sales productivity metrics. Monitor adherence to sales processes, CRM hygiene, and opportunity management standards. Sales Productivity and Performance Improvement. Analyze sales productivity across teams, geographies, products, and sales channels. Conduct win loss analysis and identify patterns impacting conversion rates and sales effectiveness. Partner with sales managers to improve funnel conversion, sales velocity, and overall productivity. Establish sales scorecards and performance benchmarks across different sales motions. Drive structured root cause analysis for underperformance and recommend improvement plans. Track effectiveness of interventions and continuously refine sales processes.

Sales Enablement and Readiness: Partner with product, presales, marketing, and business teams to equip sales teams with the knowledge and tools required to sell Paytm AI products effectively. Own sales readiness for new product launches, feature releases, pricing updates, and GTM initiatives. Develop and maintain sales enablement assets including pitch decks, product overviews, battlecards, case studies, objection handling guides, demo scripts, and FAQs. Organize and conduct sales training programs, certifications, workshops, and enablement sessions. Ensure sales teams are equipped to articulate product value propositions, use cases, competitive differentiation, and business outcomes. Continuously gather feedback from sales teams and customers to improve enablement content and training effectiveness.

Deal Support and Strategic Programs: Support sales teams on strategic opportunities by helping structure value propositions, business cases, and customer presentations. Work with business, product, and presales teams to address recurring objections and strengthen sales messaging. Drive special initiatives aimed at improving adoption of new products, sales motions, or market segments. Coordinate cross functional efforts required to improve sales effectiveness and customer acquisition outcomes. Support leadership reviews with insights, recommendations, and action plans.

Insights and Reporting: Build and maintain executive dashboards tracking funnel health, conversion metrics, productivity, and sales performance. Develop data driven insights on customer segments, product performance, channel effectiveness, and sales trends. Provide regular performance updates to leadership highlighting opportunities, risks, and required actions. Support annual planning exercises by providing insights on sales capacity, productivity, and growth opportunities. Establish measurement frameworks to evaluate the impact of enablement and sales excellence initiatives.

Ideal Candidate Profile: 7 to 12 years of experience in Sales Excellence, Sales Enablement, Revenue Operations, Business Operations, GTM Strategy, Consulting, or Sales Strategy roles. Experience working closely with enterprise sales teams in SaaS, enterprise technology, fintech, CPaaS, CRM, AI, cloud, or software businesses. Strong understanding of B2B sales funnels, enterprise sales cycles, pipeline management, and sales productivity metrics. Proven experience running sales reviews, performance management processes, and sales enablement programs. Experience creating sales training programs, sales collateral, battlecards, playbooks, and product readiness initiatives. Strong analytical skills with the ability to convert data into actionable business insights. Excellent stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence senior sales leaders and cross functional teams. bility to balance analytical rigor with practical execution. High ownership mindset and comfort operating in a fast paced environment.

Skills and Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, Economics, Statistics, or a related field. MBA preferred. Strong analytical skills with advanced proficiency in Excel and presentation tools. Experience with CRM platforms such as Salesforce, HubSpot, LeadSquared, or similar tools. Strong understanding of sales performance metrics, forecasting, funnel analytics, and productivity measurement. Excellent communication, presentation, and training skills. Ability to create executive level reports, dashboards, and business reviews. Experience with BI tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or similar platforms is preferred. Familiarity with AI, SaaS, enterprise software, CRM, marketing automation, or customer engagement platforms is preferred.

Title: Sr. Manager/DGM - Sales Manager

About Us: Paytm is India's leading digital payments and financial services company. Our platform offers a wide range of payment solutions to consumers and merchants, including utility payments, money transfers, and Paytm Payment Instruments (PPI) such as Paytm Wallet, Paytm UPI, and Paytm Payments Bank Net-Banking. We also provide merchant services, advertising, and a Mini app store. With a focus on growth and engagement, we leverage data science to drive sustainable success. We offer credit services sourced from financial partners to further support merchants.

About the Role: We are looking for a result-oriented and customer-focused professional to lead the Customer Success Sales (CS Sales) function for Paytm Money. The role involves driving customer activation and conversion across onboarding and engagement journeys, managing sales operations teams, and improving customer experience through structured calling and process excellence.

Responsibilities : Drive conversion and activation across customer onboarding and engagement funnels for various products. 
Identify and resolve customer journey bottlenecks to improve activation and conversion metrics. 
Manage and mentor the calling team to improve lead conversion and customer activation metrics. 
Monitor daily performance metrics and share updated MIS reports with stakeholders. Conduct training sessions and ensure quality assurance (QA) standards for the team. Design and optimize calling processes, customer communication flows, and conversion pitches. 
Collaborate with product, operations, risk, and business teams to resolve customer journey bottlenecks. 
Analyze customer objections and rejection patterns to improve conversion strategiesEnsure high levels of customer engagement, responsiveness, and service quality during interactionsTrack team productivity, conversion funnels, and operational KPIs to drive continuous improvementSupport leadership with business updates, operational insights, and process improvement recommendations.

Expectations/ Requirements: Minimum 5 years of Sales experience, with Stock Broking Industry experience.
Strong communication and convincing skillsCustomer-centric approach with problem-solving mindset.
Ability to handle high-volume lead follow-ups efficientlyBasic understanding of financial products, customer onboarding, and digital engagement processes is preferred.
Good coordination and stakeholder management abilitiesFamiliarity with CRM tools and Excel is preferred.
Prior experience in sales, telesales, fintech, or broking domain is an advantageHigh ownership mindset with strong execution capabilities.

Education: Any Graduate

Why join us: We give immense opportunities to make a difference and have a great time doing that. You are challenged and encouraged here to do meaning work for yourself and customers/clients We are successful, and our successes are rooted in our people's collective energy and unwavering focus on the customer, and that's how it will always beWith over 500 million+ registered users, 35 million+ merchants, and a wealth of data in our ecosystem, we are uniquely positioned to democratize credit and shape India's largest digital lending and payments story.

Compensation: We offer competitive compensation reflecting your contribution. 
If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you.

If you're ready to join Paytm as Sales Executive, apply now and be part of our success story.

About Paytm

Paytm is a pioneer of digital payments in India, serving over 450 million consumers and 45 million merchants across payments, financial services, and commerce. Over the years, Paytm has built deep in-house capabilities across technology, data, and operations to operate at scale with high reliability.
Paytm is building a full stack AI platform focussed on Inference and Agents, enabling large enterprises to deploy AI driven automation across sales, service, operations, and analytics.
The Inference and Agentic AI team operates as a cross functional unit spanning engineering, product, data science, business management, and sales, and owns the full lifecycle of AI.

Role Overview

Paytm is looking to hire Sales Operations Managers to drive financial and operational rigor across its AI Inference and Agentic AI business.
This role sits at the core of sales operations, working closely with sales, business management, and central finance teams to ensure accurate billing, collections, and revenue recognition.
The role involves owning the full order to cash lifecycle, strengthening revenue assurance, and managing procurement and vendor operations for the AI charter.
The candidate will play a key role in building scalable, audit ready systems that improve financial control, reduce leakage, and enable efficient business growth.

Key Responsibilities

Order to Cash Operations
Own end to end invoicing for enterprise AI deals from contract trigger to invoice generation, dispatch, and acknowledgement.
Maintain a central invoicing tracker covering deal terms, billing milestones, invoice status, and collections.
Coordinate with central finance and accounts receivable teams to ensure GST compliant, PO aligned, and accurately booked invoices.
Drive collections follow ups with enterprise clients in partnership with business teams and escalate overdue receivables.
Manage billing adjustments including credit notes, disputes, and corrections.

Revenue Assurance and Financial Control
Reconcile contract terms, invoicing, collections, and revenue recognition on a monthly basis.
Identify and flag revenue leakage across under billing, missed milestones, or untracked usage.
Own the monthly revenue close cycle for the AI business in coordination with central finance teams.
Maintain audit ready documentation and transaction trails to support compliance and reporting requirements.

Procurement and Vendor Operations
Manage end to end procurement workflows including vendor onboarding, purchase orders, GRN processing, and invoice approvals.
Track spend against approved budgets and highlight deviations to finance and business stakeholders.
Coordinate with procurement, legal, and treasury teams for vendor contracts, renewals, and payment cycles.
Maintain vendor master data including contract terms, SLAs, and payment schedules.

Accounting Liaison and Compliance
Act as the single point of contact for accounting, tax, and audit teams for all AI business transactions.
Ensure accurate mapping of transactions to GL codes, cost centers, and legal entities.
Support internal and external audits with required data, documentation, and clarifications.
Track input tax credits and ensure compliance with applicable tax regulations.

Process Improvement and Reporting
Build dashboards to track invoicing timelines, collections ageing, vendor payments, and revenue leakage.
Drive standardization and documentation of SOPs across finance operations workflows.
Identify opportunities to automate processes and improve operational efficiency at scale.

Ideal Candidate Profile

2 to 4 years of experience in finance operations, revenue operations, sales operations, or business finance roles.
Strong understanding of order to cash processes, invoicing, collections, and revenue recognition.
Experience working with cross functional teams including sales, finance, procurement, and legal.
High attention to detail with strong ownership of financial accuracy and compliance.
Ability to manage multiple workflows and drive execution in a fast paced environment.
Strong problem solving skills with ability to identify gaps and improve processes.
Familiarity with enterprise or SaaS business models is a plus.

Skills and Qualifications

Strong understanding of financial operations including invoicing, collections, and reconciliation.
Working knowledge of accounting concepts, GST, and compliance requirements.
Strong analytical skills with ability to track metrics and identify issues.
Proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets for tracking and reconciliation.
Experience with ERP systems and finance tools is preferred.
Strong communication skills for stakeholder coordination and issue resolution.
Bachelor’s degree in Commerce, Finance, Business, or related field, CA or MBA is a plus.

The Sales Executive / Sr. Sales Executive will be responsible for driving sales of insurance  products such as Health Insurance. The ideal candidate will be adept at converting leads,  understanding customer needs, and generating insights that help refine lead quality and  sales strategies.

● Generate and convert sales leads for Health insurance products.
